column1: Each area is designed for tranquility and connection, from swimming in the 15ft infinity pool and enjoying breakfast cooked by the Lago team to family-style dinners in the open-plan living area and relaxing in the home cinema snug. column1: Overlooking Lembongan’s beautiful surf breaks, Aqua Nusa’s villa offerings are positioned in the most sought after location on Nusa Lembongan on the hill in the main village of Jungut Batu. The location offers incredible panoramic views of the Island’s crystal clear waters.

Our villas are conveniently located within walking distance to many of Nusa Lembongan’s best venues on the hill in Jungut Batu, with spectacular views to be enjoyed along the boardwalk, providing the options for guests to dine out and explore or enjoy a romantic night in.

Also situated within walking distance are beautiful beaches and guests can explore our magical surroundings or take it in from the privacy of their own balcony. The island offers all sorts of water activities which aare all within walking distance – just head down Jungut Batu Beach or Coconuts beach – for swimming, snorkeling and stand up paddle boarding. Directly out the front of Aqua Nusa villas are two world class surf breaks – Playgrounds and Lacerations.

Guests of Aqua Nusa’s also receive complementary access to Nusa Lembongan’s premier beach lounge, Ohana’s  with complimentary transport to and from the venue. Ohana’s is the perfect place to relax by the beach during the day with beachfront daybeds and infinity pool.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tab][vc_tab title=""Rooms"" tab_id=""1421055594-2-62""][vc_column_text css=""""][vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='32px' up='' down='']

Villa Bunga is our largest villa set on 265m2 block amongst traditional Balinese style gardens. The villa features 3-bedrooms each with private marble ensuites as well as separate powder room by the private pool.

Situated on the Jungut Batu Hill in Nusa Lembongan this large villa is brilliantly located yet designed as the perfect private retreat for couples or small groups staying on the island. IT is located close to the bars and restaurants along the waterfront.

The private pool is screened with tropical plants and surrounded by comfortable sun beds with ample sun protection. The pool and courtyard area is a great attraction to this villa with plenty of choice for relaxing and sun baking in your private retreat

column2: an open plan dining area, TV room and kitchen, equipped with a full-sized fridge, gas cooktop, microwave and all necessary utensils. The secluded balcony features a beautiful day bed which is the perfect place for relaxing.

column2: >Batu Karang Resort and Day Spa offers impeccable service and all the essential amenities to invigorate travellers.

>The ambiance of Batu Karang Resort and Day Spa is reflected in every guestroom. Spacious villas are an indulgence with a modern décor with Balinese accents and the finest amenities. Outdoor bathrooms afford complete privacy and luxury and balconies with day beds are featured for guests to relax and to embrace the breathtaking panoramic views of the ocean, east coast of Bali and the magnificent silhouette of Mount Agung.

[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" padding_bottom=""40"" css_animation="""" background_color=""#ffffff""][vc_column][vc_tabs style=""boxed""][vc_tab title=""Overview"" tab_id=""1623382613298-3-1""][vc_column_text css=""""]Kalm Lembongan is a boutique resort on the main street of Jungutbatu, bringing together considered accommodation, dining, wellness and island life in one relaxed setting.

With just 18 villas, suites and rooms across three distinct categories, Kalm offers an intimate place to stay in one of Nusa Lembongan’s most convenient locations. From private pool villas to relaxed island rooms, each space brings together natural materials, considered details and a warm, understated sense of comfort, designed for restful nights and easy days in between.

Guests can spend their days by the pool, enjoy breakfast, lunch or dinner at Kalm Kitchen, or settle in for a drink at the Pool Bar. Kalm Kitchen is also open to visitors, creating a relaxed meeting place for both resort guests and the wider island community.

Wellness and movement form an important part of the Kalm experience. The Movement Shala is housed within a 40-year-old Javanese joglo, while the Recovery Pavilion features a sauna and two ice baths. A two-room Spa offers space to unwind, and the air-conditioned Cowork Lounge provides a comfortable place to work, read or catch up between days spent exploring the island.
For those looking to venture further, Kalm Charters offers private charters and transfers aboard Kalm’s 17-metre vessel, opening up the waters around Nusa Lembongan, Nusa Penida and beyond.

Located close to Jungutbatu’s beach, surf breaks, cafés, restaurants and local shops, Kalm makes it easy to experience the island at your own pace, whether you’re here to surf, explore, move, unwind or simply slow down.

column1: The Sanctuary is a spacious private retreat designed for slow, easy island living, offering 67–80m² of indoor and outdoor space surrounded by lush tropical greenery. Set within a private garden, the room features a comfortable king bed, private plunge pool and pool deck, open-air shower, and private surfboard rack. Natural materials and warm timber create a calm, inviting atmosphere, while modern comforts including air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, reverse osmosis filtered water, minibar fridge, coffee and tea facilities, and an in-room safe ensure a comfortable stay.

The Flow is a spacious and relaxed 27–35m² retreat designed for easy island living, combining warm textures, simple design and thoughtful comforts. Available with either a king or twin beds, each suite has its own character, with variations in layout, size and outlook. Comfortable and inviting, The Flow offers a calm space to unwind, with everything you need for a laid-back stay surrounded by the natural beauty of the island.

The Nest is a cosy and inviting retreat designed as an easy base for enjoying island life. At 28m², the room combines warm timber and natural textures with simple, thoughtful touches to create a comfortable space to unwind after a day exploring Lembongan. Featuring a king bed that can also be configured as twin singles, The Nest is a relaxed and welcoming space for couples, friends or solo travellers.

column1: Open daily from 6.30am–10pm, Kalm Kitchen at Kalm Lembongan in Jungutbatu is a relaxed all-day restaurant and bar serving breakfast favourites, light bites, generous mains and local flavours in a beautiful tropical setting. Overlooking the pool and surrounded by lush gardens, it’s the perfect spot for morning coffee, a leisurely meal, sunset drinks or dinner with friends, with a drinks menu ranging from freshly brewed coffee and smoothies to cocktails, wine and more. Open to both resort guests and visitors, Kalm Kitchen combines good food, considered drinks and warm service for relaxed island dining at your own pace.

Open to everyone on the island, Kalm Cowork Lounge at Kalm Lembongan in Jungutbatu is a relaxed, air-conditioned workspace with high-speed Wi-Fi, comfortable work areas, sofa seating and garden spaces. Whether you’re catching up on work, answering emails, reading or taking a break, the lounge offers a quiet and flexible place to settle in, with food, coffee and drinks from Kalm Kitchen delivered straight to your table. Daily, weekly and monthly Cowork Passes are available, while Kalm resort guests enjoy complimentary access.

Based in Nusa Lembongan, Kalm Charters offers private, customisable experiences around Bali and the surrounding islands, from seamless transfers and sunset cruises to full-day adventures and personalised itineraries. The vessel accommodates up to 25 guests and features comfortable indoor and outdoor spaces, premium amenities, refreshments and a dedicated local crew. Explore destinations including Nusa Penida, Ceningan, Lombok, the Gili Islands and Bali’s east coast at your own pace, whether you’re planning a snorkelling trip, romantic sunset cruise, special celebration or relaxed day on the water. With flexible itineraries and charter options tailored to each group, Kalm Charters makes it easy to experience the islands your way.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tab][vc_tab title=""Resort Map"" tab_id=""1789002546857-4-0""][vc_single_image image=""78937"" img_size=""full"" css="""" qode_css_animation=""""][/vc_tab][vc_tab title=""Location Map"" tab_id=""1417918513146-4-3b5b6-bf70""][vc_single_image image=""78697"" img_size=""medium"" alignment=""center"" onclick=""img_link_large"" css="""" qode_css_animation=""""][vc_column_text]

column1: Escape to paradise and experience a luxurious island hideaway at Villa Pantai. Set on 2,280m2 of land, Villa Pantai is a fully-staffed, modern, Balinese style villa with beach access just steps away. Planned to surround a central, infinity edge swimming pool, the villa includes a large, open plan living pavilion and stunning views to the pool and ocean beyond.
Villa Pantai includes 7 spacious and well appointed suites comfortably sleeping up to 18 guests.

Configuration includes 6 suites with king-size beds and a suite with 3 large bunk beds. There two master bedrooms with private ensuite, and two pods each consisting of two rooms with interconnecting doors and a shared bathroom.  Two of the king-size beds can be split into twin share, single beds on request. A folding cot is available for infants.
Each air-conditioned suite features soaring high ceilings and an ensuite garden bathroom, fitted with soothing rain showers and double vanity units.

Both master bedrooms include a private terrace with rattan armchairs and table offering the perfect place to sit back and relax. The Master Suite terrace faces the beach, offering sweeping views of the ocean, and out to majestic Mount Agung beyond. Yet the scenery is not lost from any of the rooms at Villa Pantai, with the remaining suites facing out to beautifully manicured gardens.
This is the ultimate holiday villa!
The villa also has a rumpus room, gym and massage bale.

column1: Arrival is through a set of antique Javanese gates into a beautifully landscaped garden. A pathway leads you to the main house and upon entry, the dramatic waterfront setting of the property is immediately evident. The large open-plan living, dining and kitchen area leads out to timber decking and a large pool which seems to blend seamlessly with the ocean beyond.  Exquisite finishes and sumptuous interiors put this property at the very high end of island living.  A beautifully fitted kitchen and a bathtub in every bathroom, not to mention a breathtaking view, will make you want to extend your stay at Villa Tranquilla Nusa Lembongan and never leave this paradise.

The spacious master bedroom in Villa Tranquilla Nusa Lembongan has a private terrace right on the cliff-edge and a bathroom almost set over the ocean.  Sit back in the cliff-side bathtub, a glass of bubbly in your hand admiring the view and you might never leave . Two junior suites and a media room complete the set up in the main house. The fourth bedroom is in a separate guesthouse and includes bunk-beds, making this an ideal suite for a couple with young children.
Villa Tranquilla Nusa Lembongan sleeps up to 12 people.
Wonderful stay overall in very spacious and highly staffed Vila
Lots of space, beautiful grounds, magnificent view over the sea

column2: >This house is just gorgeous!! Unbelievable! It's just amazing!! Go there with your eyes closed. The staff is so kind that I can't express it enough!

column1: Villa Tranquilla is special and couldn’t think of a better place to unwind and recharge.

Our host met us from boat and personally showed us around the property. Breakfast was home cooked to order by dedicated staff. Staff were lovely and couldn’t be more welcoming and helpful in organising activities, transport, lunch/dinner bookings, in-villa spa treatments etc. The villa’s design, gardens and view are exceptional (especially the sunsets) and sound of the ocean create the most relaxing setting. Very private and peaceful location, but within easy walking distance of sandy bay beach club (also very nice), spas etc. Dinner is also available in-villa if you wish, which is a really nice option and good value. Fridge is stocked with beer, wine and soft drinks at similar price to shops.

column2: >Stunning! Our first visit to Lembongan and we loved it! Villa Tranquilla has breathtaking views, large open spaces, large bedrooms and ensuites, staff, a movie room etc Master suite with epic views of ocean and huge pool 2 x interconnecting rooms with own ensuites 1 x separate villa with King bed and a set of bunks Every bedroom has aircon and a huge open air ensuite. We barely left the sunbeds but the pool as it was so beautiful and relaxing. Putu and his team cooked and cleaned for us and were very helpful organising motorbikes, taxi’s, dinner reservations and giving us advice on things to see and do. They brought us back some snacks and recommended some coconut when my daughter got Bali belly. Very thoughtful. It is about a 2 minute walk to Sandy Bay beach club which is a very family friendly restaurant overlooking a fairly rough beach. The food was delicious. You must do a snorkelling trip to see Manta Point and Crystal bay. We would 100% return to Villa Tranquilla.

column1: The most amazing property I have stayed in

This beautiful villa is worth every cent. The staff are amazing. The villa has the most amazing view and is beautifully set up. The main room has the most amazing view and indoor/outdoor bathroom. 100m to a rooftop sunrise bar and restaurant(basic food) but still good. Owners of the bar are local Balinese brothers which was passed down generations. We had massages in the villa and orders scooters which were dropped to our villa. I would recommend this place every day of the week and make sure you don’t skip on the rooftop bar and food 100m down the road. It’s worth the sunset (get there early as it does fill up) When we come back again we will definitely book again

column2: >Lembongan Island Villas is centrally located on the renowned “hill” of Jungut Batu, making it the perfect tropical home away from home. A 30-minute boat ride from Bali is all that separates you staying at Nusa Lembongan's favourite resort. Our villas have been designed with the perfect mix of privacy and proximity, boasting easy access to the best attractions, beaches, restaurants, and activities that Nusa Lembongan has to offer.

>Ideal for both new and repeat guests, Lembongan Island Villas is a favourite for couples and families. Each one of our 10 Villas has been thoughtfully decorated with inspiration from traditional Balinese designs and infused with the soul of authentic island living. Lembongan Island Villas is perfect for a family holiday or romantic getaway, the soothing tones of white and timber create a serene and relaxing atmosphere for your stay.

>Head down to the communal area, where our resort restaurant, bar, an infinity pool and sun loungers await.  From your pool lounge you can almost touch the white sands and turquoise waters of Jungut Batu beach.
>Take a dip in the pool, enjoy a mouthwatering drink, indulge in scrumptious food, and appreciate the awe-inspiring ocean views that stretch to Bali and beyond.

>Strategically located at the entrance of the boardwalk, Lembongan Island Beach Villas is the perfect starting point for your foodie adventures. Immerse yourself in a world of flavours with international and local cuisines just a few steps away from your doorstep, or dine with your toes in the sand at one of the many beach cafés. Most restaurants in Nusa Lembongan have on-call drivers and can provide return transport to your villa at no extra cost.  The front office team will be more than happy to assist with making restaurant reservations for you.

>Calling all beach bums, you will be pleased to know that Coconut Beach is just a stone's throw away from your villa. Enjoy the serene waters perfect for swimming and sunbathing, or make your way to Playgrounds and Lacerations surf breaks, just a short paddle away. SUP boards, kayaks, masks, and snorkels are available to rent for those wanting to explore the nearby waters. Water Taxis can provide return transport to Shipwrecks and Razors surf breaks for a small fee.

>Experience the underwater wonders of Nusa Lembongan by snorkelling or scuba diving. World famous for its azure blue waters and lively reefs, you will be mesmerized by the spectacular marine life on display. Several dive/snorkelling operations are located close by, and will guide you on an unforgettable aquatic journey.
>Remember to be respectful of the environment and practice eco-friendly tourism.
>Take a break from your action-packed day and pamper yourself at <a href=""https://www.thelembongantraveller.com/portfolio_page/spring-spa-sanctuary-nusa-lembongan/"">Spring Day Spa &amp
column3: Sanctuary. Located a short 3-minute walk away from your villa, luxury is literally at your fingertips. Choose from a wide variety of professional treatments, all designed to leave you feeling rejuvenated and refreshed.

column2: >It was in an amazing location overlooking the beach. The pool was lovely with sunbeds surrounding it. The staff were always helpful. column2: >Great spot. Close restaurants and ferry. Awesome view. Great staff, great food. Pool is amazing.. the photos don’t do the view justice. Even better in real life.

column1: Fantastic place to stay, we have 2 boys around 10 years old and this was great for us. Place felt safe for them to get around alone. column2: >We were well received, our suitcases were taken to our villa. Was a walk uphill, but the view makes up for it! Beautiful accommodation and definitely recommended for when you visit the island.

column2: >It was just beautiful. The view were stunning the staff all lovely, the location perfect.

column2: >Very nice villa with all the comforts expected and well located. We really enjoyed our stay, very kind and welcoming staff.

column1: This was our 6th (we think) time staying at LIBV. The staff are what make it amazing! A big shout out to Yudi, Kadek and Adit at the pool and resto. The price has increased alot $650ish AUD a night is steep for a single family and this is possibly the only downfall. We love it though as it feels like home! Highly recommend Santya Bikes for scooter hire.

column1: The Palms Ceningan Resort is perched up on a clifftop right in front of the famous Ceningan surf break. You can sit in style on our huge iron wood deck whilst watching the waves and washing your worries away!!
Not only do we have the best ocean views on the island, you can swim and relax sipping cocktails in our big infinity edge pool.

Our Balinese style bungalows incorporate 5 star luxuries and coziness, combined with Egyptian cotton sheets along with the best pillows and mattresses you will have ever lay on. The rooms also include hot cold water, a/c,mini bar fridges, satellite TV, LED TVs, DVD, fans, computer table, free WiFi, and in house movies.

We also boast a top quality restaurant with different tastes from all around the world -  you will not be disappointed! We also have a full service deck bar which is fully stocked with any drink you may desire along with the most fantastic cocktails you can imagine!
Our friendly staff will be here to help and serve you  at anytime of the day or night .
Your stay at The Palms Ceningan Resort will be a full boutique hotel experience, which boasts style atmosphere and the most stunning sunsets on offer...you will love it.

Bali ECO Deli is a welcoming café and restaurant located in Jungut Batu, Nusa Lembongan, offering fresh, wholesome food in a relaxed tropical garden setting. Known for its healthy breakfasts, nourishing lunches to dinners, and quality coffee, Bali ECO Deli is a favourite spot for locals and travellers looking for flavourful food made with care.

Our menu focuses on fresh, mostly organic, and locally sourced ingredients, with a wide range of options including plant-based dishes, vegetarian and vegan meals. From popular breakfast favourites and smoothie bowls to hummus plates, colourful stir-fries, sandwiches, and homemade desserts, every dish is prepared daily with attention to quality and balance.

Bali ECO Deli is especially loved for its specialty coffee, fresh juices, and relaxed brunch atmosphere. Guests can enjoy their meal in our covered garden seating, making it a comfortable place to unwind any time of day.
Whether you’re stopping by for a healthy breakfast, a casual lunch or dinner, or coffee and treats, our friendly team is always happy to welcome you.
With generous portions, fair prices, and high hygiene standards, Bali ECO Deli aims to provide consistently good food in a calm and friendly environment.
Conveniently located on the main road of Jungut Batu, it’s an ideal stop before or after exploring Nusa Lembongan.
If you’re searching for healthy food, great coffee, and a relaxed café in Jungut Batu, Bali ECO Deli is a place you’ll want to return to.

""description"": ""Bali Eco Deli is a welcoming café and restaurant in Jungut Batu, Nusa Lembongan, serving healthy breakfasts, brunch, lunch and dinner in a relaxed tropical garden setting. The menu focuses on fresh, mostly organic and locally sourced ingredients, with plant-based, vegetarian and vegan options, specialty coffee, smoothie bowls, hummus plates, stir-fries, sandwiches and homemade desserts."",
""text"": ""Bali Eco Deli is located on the main road of Jungut Batu, Nusa Lembongan, Bali, Indonesia. It is easily accessible from most accommodation in the Jungut Batu area.""
""name"": ""What are Bali Eco Deli's opening hours?"",
""text"": ""Bali Eco Deli is open every day from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM, serving breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner.""
""name"": ""Does Bali Eco Deli have vegan and vegetarian options?"",
""text"": ""Yes. Bali Eco Deli offers a wide range of plant-based, vegetarian and vegan dishes, including smoothie bowls, hummus plates, colourful stir-fries, sandwiches and homemade desserts.""
""text"": ""No. Bali Eco Deli does not offer delivery, but take-away is available. Guests can dine in the covered tropical garden seating or collect their order to go.""
""name"": ""What kind of food does Bali Eco Deli serve?"",

""text"": ""Bali Eco Deli serves fresh, mostly organic and locally sourced food, including healthy breakfasts, smoothie bowls, brunch dishes, lunch and dinner meals, specialty coffee, fresh juices and homemade desserts.""
""name"": ""Is Bali Eco Deli good for families?"",
""text"": ""Yes. Bali Eco Deli is family friendly with generous portions, fair prices, garden seating and a calm, relaxed atmosphere that suits travellers of all ages.""
""name"": ""How do I view the Bali Eco Deli menu?"",
""text"": ""The full Bali Eco Deli menu is available online at https://baliecodeli.net/menu/ and includes breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner, beverages and dessert sections.""

Everything you need in one place.
Located on the beautiful white sands of Sandy Bay Beach, overlooking the iconic Devil’s Tear, Sandy Bay Beach Club is an all-day destination for food, relaxation, family time and island living.

Start your morning with a delicious breakfast by the ocean, enjoy a leisurely lunch, relax by the pool, and stay through sunset for drinks and dinner. Our menu brings together world-class Western cuisine and local favourites, alongside an extensive drinks selection.

With two swimming pools, including a dedicated kids’ pool, there’s space for everyone to enjoy the day. Our kids’ area gives little ones a place to play and explore, while parents can sit back and enjoy the beautiful beachfront setting.

Every day from 3:30 PM – 5:30 PM, children can also join our Pizza Making Experience, where they can make their own pizza and enjoy it fresh from the kitchen. And for an extra treat, cool down with our delicious gelatos and popsicles.
Sandy Bay is also the only beach club on Sandy Bay Beach, offering a more intimate beachfront experience with the sand and ocean right at your doorstep.

Take a little piece of the island home with you from Sandy Bay Boutique. Browse our curated collection of resort wear, beach essentials, accessories, gifts and unique island finds, perfect for adding a little Lembongan style to your holiday or finding something special to take home.
For the best in island-style accommodation, discover The Shacks and private pool villas at Sandy Bay.

For larger groups and families, The Beach House offers four bedrooms, a private infinity pool and a stunning beachfront setting, the perfect place to spend quality time together, celebrate special occasions or simply enjoy an island holiday with the people you love.
For a little extra holiday pampering, visit our spa, operated by Glo Spa from Bali, and take some time to relax and unwind.

column2: >Dive into paradise, Australian-owned Bali Hai Diving Adventures is the original pioneer for diving in Lembongan/Penida and the most established 5-star PADI Dive Center in Bali and Nusa Lembongan Island has over 30 years of experience with a 100% safety record.

column3: Stay Package at Hai Tide Beach Resort, Mushroom Beach, Nusa Lembongan
Stay Package in North West Bali at Menjangan Dynasty Resort

column2: >The Discover Lembongan Scuba Day Trip is an all-inclusive scuba diving experience, consisting of one dive from our pontoon, perfect for beginners. Starting in mainland Bali, we'll pick you up at Benoa Harbor and ferry you to Nusa Lembongan, a small tropical island with crystal-clear waters and golden sand beaches. Upon arrival, we'll drop anchor alongside our purpose-built pontoon, which will serve as your jumping-off point for all of your aquatic adventures. First-time divers will receive a thorough explanation before taking their first breaths underwater. During your session, an experienced PADI professional will guide you through the entire experience and never leave your side. Once you've gotten the hang of it, you'll be transfixed by the stellar coral reefs and abundance of tropical marine life. It's truly an unforgettable experience. When you're not diving, you can take advantage of other aquatic activities aboard the pontoon, including snorkelling, parasailing, kayaking, banana boat rides, semi-submersible coral viewing, an underwater viewing chamber, and diving boards, and a 35m-waterslide.

column3: Dive package includes two nights at the Hai Tide Beach Resort, and three days exploring Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Penida, with four total dives. As you're staying with us, you can also choose to go night diving and increase your chance of seeing nocturnal critters such as shrimp, octopi, and hunting moray eels! Hai Tide Beach Resort is located in Nusa Lembongan's Mushroom Bay. It's a tranquil and peaceful setting, perfect for relaxing after an exciting, but long day underwater. Each lumbung is literally seconds away from the pristine golden sand of Mushroom Bay, so you can enjoy listening to the waves as you fall asleep. This package is recommended to qualified divers, but please inquire if you're a beginner.

column2: >“Please note that our system only allows a booking of a maximum of two people. When making a booking for more than two, please send us an enquiry directly to reservations@balihaidiving.com”

Beginners will dive from a purpose-built pontoon under the supervision of an experienced PADI professional. Meanwhile certified divers will be whisked away to one of 20 different dive sites, depending on the time of year and weather conditions. These sites include Crystal, Manta Bay, and S.D. Point and more.

column1: 23701,"TIGERLILLYS RESTAURANT","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""full_width"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]

Tigerlilly's Restaurant offers a refreshing escape where lush tropical Balinese gardens blend seamlessly with fun, eclectic design, creating a laid-back vibe that invites you to relax and enjoy the island atmosphere at any time of day. With its warm, welcoming ambiance, Tigerlilly’s is the perfect spot for breakfast, lunch, or dinner—or even just a casual visit to enjoy the surroundings and unwind.

Our all-day menu caters to diverse tastes, with a tempting selection of Western favorites, Asian-inspired options, and traditional Indonesian dishes. Each dish is crafted to be both delicious and budget-friendly, making it a great choice whether you’re craving something familiar or keen to try local flavors. And if you’re looking for the perfect drink to accompany your meal, our cocktails are a must-try, known for their creativity and flavor that adds an extra touch to your Tigerlilly’s experience.

Not just a place to eat, Tigerlilly's is ideal for anyone who loves a no-fuss, unique spot with great vibes and a welcoming feel. Take a moment to relax with friends, meet fellow travelers, or simply enjoy the good music as you savor each bite or sip. Our team is here to make sure you have a great time, so whether you're popping in for a quick meal or planning to linger, you’ll feel right at home.

Tigerlilly’s is open every day from 7:30 am to 10:00 pm, with last food orders at 9:30 pm. Drop in and let the vibrant atmosphere, delicious food, and island charm leave you with memories of Nusa Lembongan that are as refreshing as they are unforgettable.

column1: • 2 BR option (Part of the 3 BR with one bedroom closed off and only available during low season period)

Villa Sayang is divided into two sections: one with 3 bedrooms and another with 4 bedrooms located 50 meters away, accessible through a separate entrance. Each section can be booked individually or combined.
The full Villa features a poolside living and dining bale which both over look the ocean and provide the perfect location to dine and relax taking in the breathtaking views.
There is also an outdoor living bale with satellite TV and video, making it an ideal chillout zone.
Villa Sayang’s 5 full time staff are there to assist you with your stay and available to cook for you offering both local Indonesian &amp
column2: Western cuisine. A full range of meals from snacks to 3 course sit-down dinners are available during your stay at Villa Sayang Nusa Lembongan.

column1: Your personal chef, Kadek, can advise on a specific meal or you can select individual dishes from the everyday menu.
Villa Sayang has an air conditioned massage room where you can retreat and be pampered with massage, manicure, pedicure or rejuvinating treatment.
The villa boat and skipper is available for all guests for complimentary drop off / pick up to surf breaks and snorkelling in the main bay.
Villa Sayang Nusa Lembongan also provides snorkelling equipment for you to use during your stay.

column1: To all the wonderful people at Villa Sayang

Thank you all for a truly special holiday. From the moment we arrived at the villa we were warmly welcomed and had to literally do nothing for 5 days. Gede and Komang organised absolutely everything we wanted to do, which made exploring the island an easy and enjoyable experience. The massage girls were exceptional and we loved that we did not have to go offsite to have these done. A very special thanks to the wonderful team in the kitchen. Every meal was a delight and the fruit platters at breakfast were delicious. Villa Sayang and Nusa Lembongan have really made an impression on all of us and we will definitely be visiting again.

column2: >Really happy with our say. The amenities and staff were excellent. Would stay again!

column1: <em>What a girls trip! 14 of us arrived at the villa &amp
column2: we were blown away. The view from the villa is spectacular. The villa overlooks the water &amp
column3: it in a great location. The villa is so clean and well looked after. What made our experience so memorable was the staff. Gede the house manager was so attentive and although it was his first day working as house manager, nothing was too much trouble &amp
column4: he was so professional. He made our holiday a true holiday! The food was beautiful too. We ate many meals there and the food did not disappoint.

column1: <em>Komang was our boat driver. He was an excellent skipper to the boat &amp
column2: it was so awesome having a boat included in the villa that could drop us off to surfing locations , and snorkeling spots. It really was the best trip ever &amp
column3: thanks to all the staff! Highly highly recommend! We would love to return.

column2: >We had the most incredible time at Villa Sayang in Nusa Lembongan. From the moment we arrived, we were made to feel completely at home. Gede and Komang were absolute superstars – so warm, attentive, and thoughtful. Nothing was ever too much trouble, and they looked after our every need.
>We ordered dinner from the in-villa menu one evening, and it turned out to be the best Indonesian meal we had during our entire trip.

>The villa itself is spectacular – the infinity pool overlooking the ocean is breathtaking, and the views are next-level. Every part of the villa was spotless and beautifully styled, with that perfect mix of luxury and island charm.
>If you're heading to Lembongan, Villa Sayang is an absolute must. We’re already planning our return!

column1: Stayed 12 beautiful days❤️. GEDE Komang Julie Kedek Wayan Pande, thank you for the best experience at your fabulous Villas.
<em>Staff is always willing to make our holiday a great experience, suggesting restaurants to view sunsets, snorkeling on the Sayang, lunch in the Village &amp

column3: always delicious. GEDE organised a suckling pig &amp
column4: decorations for a birthday celebration with so much ease, no stress for me.

column2: >We stayed in the 4 bedroom villa, our family and friends. The villa is beautifully styled, super clean and spacious - traditional Balinese style - which we all love. The location is fantastic - walking distance to the cliff top bars and restaurants, so close to the beach.

>All of the villa staff are lovely. The house manager Gede was brilliant - like a personal butler (and mixologist!)- he can organise anything for you, really easy going and professional. Komang the skipper of the boat is also fantastic - he is a skilled skipper, taking us out snorkelling and for a sunset cruise - having the private boat is a fabulous addition. All really nice people.
>The food at the villa was excellent - we had Indonesian banquet, Balinese Duck etc - so nice to eat homecooked food on holiday.
>Such a fabulous place - we have booked next year already!
>PS Sunsets from the villa are superb - no need to go anywhere

Situated on the old site of Bali Hyatt, on a rustic street of Sanur, Hyatt Regency Bali revives the classic Balinese charm in a modern setting.

Blessed with 500 m (1,640 ft) of beachfront and lush tropical gardens, the hotel is within walking distance of eclectic shops, cafés and restaurants. All 363 rooms are designed in sleek Balinese style with a private balcony overlooking the renowned garden or the calming sea.

The hotel is further enhanced with a comprehensive wellness complex Shankha, featuring ten spa villas, a yoga studio, swimming pool, 24-hour fitness center, lockers, hot and cold plunge pool, steam, sauna and juice bar.
Dining options include the beachfront Italian restaurant Pizzaria, homely Indonesian restaurant Omang Omang and classy Piano Lounge for drinks and weekly live jazz.

Relax in this comfortable room featuring a king or twin bed and 27 sq m (290 sq ft) of space with a modern Balinese touch. Each room comes with a cabana and private balcony, where guests can enjoy the serene view of garden or ocean. Max occupancy: Two adults and one infant.

Our king or twin bed Deluxe rooms offer 34 sq m (365 sq ft) of space, cosy décor and a private balcony. Enjoy amenities such as a luxurious bathroom with bathtub and extra space to unwind after a long day sightseeing. Max occupancy: Two adults and one child under six years.

This stylish 39 sq m (419 sq ft) room features a king or twin bed, work area and spacious terrace with a cabana overlooking our manicured garden. The ground floor location makes this room an ideal choice for families with young children or for couples. Max occupancy: Two adults and two children under 12 years, or three adults.

Guests with Club access can enjoy the exclusivity and privacy of the Regency Club Lounge. Nestled amongst lush greenery, the Club Lounge hosts breakfast and hors d'oeuvre from 5:00 – 7:00 PM daily and offers complimentary coffee, tea and refreshments throughout the day. Club access is available at an additional US $65 ++ per room per night, applicable to all room types.

Treat yourself to the extra space and enjoy the luxurious amenities. Choose from a Regency Suite (54 to 78 sq m / 580 to 840 sq ft), Family Suite (54 sq m / 580 sq ft) or Executive Suite for the ultimate royal treatment (81 sq m / 870 sq ft). Ideal for honeymooners or families with children, our suites features a master bedroom, spacious bathroom with bathtub and shower, living room and balcony with the best view of the resort. The well-appointed living room is equipped with its own toilet and shower, and ample space for an extra bed. Max occupancy: Two adults and two children under 12 years, or three adults.

column18: }""][/bsf-info-box][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_tab][vc_tab title=""Description"" tab_id=""1421055594-1-76e001-77c573dc-238d""][vc_column_text css=""""]Villa Tanjung is a luxury, architecturally designed villa offering 6, 5 or 4 bedroom options.  Villa Tanjung occupies a spectacular cliff top setting, with 270 degree views that extend over Nusa Lembongan’s famous surf breaks towards Bali and its sacred volcano Mount Agung.

column1: Each bedroom has its own ensuite bathroom. All bedroom suites have spectacular ocean views.  The master suite is set up with a double (king size) bed, a large walk in dressing room and a spacious bathroom with open air shower. Four suites are configured to suit either family occupancy with connecting door access between two adjoining suites – or four separate lockable bedroom suites. Two of the rooms have two single beds – which on request can be converted to a double bed. A sixth bedroom with ensuite is located next to the master bedroom with option of king or twin bedding.
Villa Tanjung prides itself on a being child-friendly, there is a large grassed area for children to play and within the pool is a shallow paddle area for toddlers.
One of the joys of staying at a private villa is not having to leave, Villa Tanjung offers an in-villa dining menu and beverage service for guests so you can relax all day at the villa.

We would like to inform you that there is construction taking place on a neighbouring property. We are in regular communication with the contractors and are doing everything we can to minimise any potential noise or disruption during your stay.
Please contact us if you have any questions.

column2: >Villa Tanjung is an amazing villa in a beautiful location. The villa itself was perfect for our group of 12. A very enjoyable stay and would definitely stay again. Komang was a very responsive manager and the villa staff kept everything perfect during our stay.

column1: Seriously incredible location - ocean, mountains, sunset - absolute paradise found. We have had the most wonderful stay here - impeccable - thank you Villa Tanjung! I can’t speak more highly of it honestly - just do yourself a favour and check it out.

column2: >This villa is sensational and the staff went above and beyond helping with everything. We loved our stay and would definitely go back and stay there again. We ate their Indonesian buffet every night in the villa which they cooked for us and it was sensational. What a fabulous trip and amazing staff.

column1: Our stay at Villa Tanjung was simply amazing! From the moment we arrived, we were blown away by the warm welcome from the team and the charm and comfort of this Villa Accommodation: The rooms were comfortable with beautiful views all around. The airconditioning allowed us to refresh after days out Amenities: Everything we needed was at our fingertips, We opted to have dinner made for us at the Villa and also had access to the fully-equipped kitchen . Loved relaxing in the outdoor pool area overlooking the stunning ocean view Location - Conveniently located near Mushroom Bay and close to Yellow Bridge. We were above to explore the Island easily and plenty of options for transport. Hospitality: Komang and the team went above and beyond to make our stay unforgettable. Exceptional service and went about there duties in the Villa with minimal disruption during our stay. Overall Experience: In short, our stay at Villa Tanjong was pure bliss. If you're looking for a relaxing getaway with all the comforts of home, this is the place to be.

column2: >We had an amazing Family Reunion there and we are greatly appreciative to both Lembongan traveller and Villa Tanjung.
>The villa was amazing, travelling there was no issues.
>Really loved the balance between fun and relaxation.
>Highlights was having massages in the villa and having your recommended Chef come in to prepare our delicious meal.
>Our family truly had a magical time there.

column1: Top of the top villa, view is fantastic and all perfect, just if I have to say for that price coffee capsules should be free!!

column2: >This place is one of the most amazing properties we have ever seen. It is extremely luxurious, the views are amazing and the staff could not have made our stay more comfortable. The house has every item you could hope for and has perfect access to the ocean below. We had 10 people in our group but could have easily had 15 and still been extremely comfortable. Cant wait to go back.

column16: Javanese architecture with an injection of modern style. Mixing the old with the new this villa has been built using reclaimed timbers (teak &amp

column1: The villa features 3 bedrooms - 2 bedrooms upstairs in the main house and a master suite across the garden.

The upstairs bedrooms share a large semi-open style bathroom downstairs surrounded with beautiful balinese stone walls. The Rooms are separated by a light and airy open den/verandah area overlooking the garden and pool. The ideal spot for an afternoon relaxing or reading a book with the soft glow of the pool reflection and the breeze to cool you down.

The master bedroom is situated across the garden in a beautiful 'joglo' inspired room. This generous sized room will have you looking in all directions at the stunning antique wooden features. There is a large stylish semi-outdoor ensuite bathroom with private walled garden outlook.

The main house boasts a large open plan living space including a relaxing lounge area, large central dining space with beautiful reclaimed teak and ironwood timber table leading onto a fully functioning kitchen.
The villa comes with staff who will assist you with your all needs.
Outstanding property, great location and so well maintained. Ketut and his team were amazing hosts! Would highly recommend.

column2: >Our stay at Villa Kasih was faultless. From the moment we stepped through the gate we were transpired into holiday mode. All zones of the villa including the pool and grounds were beautiful. Location was superb. Sunset drinks on the beach and restaurants just steps away.
column3: >Ketut and his team were amazing so accommodating always happy to help in any way they could.
column4: >Keep doing what you are doing 10/10 - We will definitely be back.

column1: One of the best Airbnb’s we’ve ever stayed at. Location is very close to the beach and the main road (restaurants, shops, coffee, bars, etc.) but still very private and relaxing. The staff helped us organize snorkeling and transportation. They were always super response. The property is great including all three bedrooms and the pool. I can’t say enough good things about this property. We were sad to leave after three days.

column1: Amazing place, located perfectly, with amazing friendly and helpful staff!

column2: >Beautiful property with lovely pool and garden. Attentive staff made simple breakfast (eggs or pancakes) and cleaned every morning. We really enjoyed the oasis of calm as a family of 4 using each of the 3 bedrooms. Surf rack for boards and exquisite bathrooms.

25545,"LEMBONGAN SURF TEAM","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""full_width"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text]Lembongan Surf Team
The first contest held in Nusa Lembongan was in 1983
column2: at “Tarsan’s Left” – now known as “Playgrounds” and was won by local surfer “Roger”. The event was organized by Paul Anderson from Australia
column3: and along with Brian and George from Seal Rocks (Australia) they had collected about 17 surfboards to take to the island and donate to the under privileged children – thus beginning the Aloha spirit that would carry on through the years to come.

column1: The Lembongan Surf Team was established in 2001 by Wayan Sujaya, Komang Werdi, Caron Farnham &amp
column2: Pedro after discussing the situation and fate to which the local surfers were faced with in regards to not only their own growth but that of the number of tourist surfers in their waters. We decided to unite the local surfers into “LST”.

column1: LST is a sporting club which places an importance on academic achievement / schooling and family values
column2: and mindful that they are also representatives of not just their island but their nation too – this in turn would help to nurture their self esteem and foster integrity into their daily lives.

column1: Each year our local contest is generally held in the months of July or August and has 3 divisions, Masters, Open &amp
column2: Grommets – thus allowing the young to old, the beginner to the experienced surfer to compete in a family like environment that exudes excitement and joy and rewards to all. Thru-out the years we have been blessed by the support and donations from our local community and businesses
column3: along with surf companies from Hawaii, Australia, Europe &amp
column5: too more recently surf companies from Bali.

column1: From the support and guidance from elders within our community
column2: Wayan Ware, Agus Tarci, Kodul Reef, Ibu Caron, Jenny &amp
column5: Rob Snoad – the level of surfing amongst our boys has risen to heights of seeing them compete successfully to becoming not only champions on the ISC Tour (Indonesian Surfing Championship) of Indonesia but also representing their country in the World Junior Championship held in New Zealand.

column1: Many of our team members have travelled to places as far as, Europe, Japan, Malaysia, Philippines, Hawaii, Australia, New Zealand &amp
column3: taking with them their island culture and spirit and returning with a new understanding of other life styles and languages to be shared with their fellow team mates – and in turn becoming respectful citizens and guides to foreign travelers and tourists to our beautiful island of Nusa Lembongan.

column1: Explore Nusa Paradise with Ceningan Divers

Experience the magic of this island from the luxury, peace &
column2: privacy of Villa Bahagia. The ultimate in island living.

column1: This spectacular villa, set on 2,500sq m, is absolute waterfront and has uninterrupted, sweeping ocean views. The entire villa, equipped with all modern amenities, is yours. Our friendly and efficient staff of four are there to ensure your stay is fantastic.

The large open bale, bordered by a 17 metre infinity pool, takes full advantage of the spectacular view as does the separate, open kitchen and the 4 separate sleeping suites separated by tropical gardens.

The villa embraces traditional Balinese design and furnishings and is finished with exquisite attention to detail. Features include high pitched, traditional thatched roofing and cool white, polished terrazzo flooring.

The villa is delightfully private but close to restaurants, cafes and all that this intriguing island has to offer –  white sandy beaches, the best beach on the island is next door, coral reefs teeming with tropical fish, a choice of world class surf breaks, renowned diving with magnificent manta rays and Mola Mola (Sunfish) and traditional temples and villages.
Villa Bahagia, which means happy in Indonesian, offers luxurious accommodation on a special island only thirty minutes by ferry from Sanur yet a world away from bustling Bali.

column1: The perfect holiday is where one can walk barefoot straight out the front gate of your own private villa on to a beautiful white sandy beach and dive directly into the pristine ocean.

This is Villa Celagi, a four bedroom, four bathroom villa set on the beachfront,where at high tide the water laps peacefully against the front wall with views to the magnificent volcano Mt Agung.  There are four dedicated staff to look after your every need and over the course of your stay you will begin to think of them more as family than staff.

Relax poolside sipping cocktails or for those who a more energetic there are several world class surf breaks which are easily accessible from the villa. Plus the adventure awaits of a whole tropical island to explore either by foot, motor scooter, golf buggy or small pick up truck.

The Villa manager is also available to arrange to take you swimming with the Manta rays or drift snorkelling . The kaleidoscope of coral colours combined with the vast number of species of beautiful fish make these underwater experiences feel like you are in a real life aquarium!

When the tranquility of night falls across the island it is time to make the difficult decision of whether to eat a specially prepared meal at the Villa or go out to one of the many fabulous restaurants on offer on Nusa Lembongan

We would like to inform you that there is construction taking place on a neighbouring property. We are in regular communication with the contractors and are doing everything we can to minimise any potential noise or disruption during your stay.
Please contact us if you have any questions.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tab][vc_tab title=""Reviews"" tab_id=""1614232589605-3-9""][vc_column_text css=""""]<span style=""color: #33cccc

column1: Beautiful beach villa in a quiet location, exceptional staff, a great week.

Nano, Kadek and Wayan were amazing! They went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and enjoyed our stay. The villa was in a fantastic location right on the beach with easy access to restaurants and activities. The rooms were comfortable and the pool and common area were perfect for a large group.

column2: >We stayed on three locations for our Bali trip and Lembongan was by far the favourite amongst all guests. The accommodation was perfect for 2 families. Large rooms all with their own bathrooms. Kitchen lounge and dining all outside overlooking the beautiful white sands and pristine waters. The pool was beautiful however after a long hot day is a bit warm. Walking out of the entry gates straight onto the sand and into natures pool, the ocean, was amazing. The villa is a short walk to fantastic cafes and restaurants however for more fine dining our hosts were always available to make bookings for venues and travel to and from. They also organised snorkelling tours and gave great recommendations on shops and exploring. At one point I needed something printed so they arranged my travel and helped me get it done. Our hosts were only a message away and were fast with responses. Highly recommend and can’t wait to come back.

column1: Incredibly happy with the staff. They were stars. The house is lovely, located right with its own beach, cozy Swedish cafe. We were traveling with a baby and it was not optimal there, but the other kids had a great time. We went fishing, and the best snorkeling tour under the auspices of those who worked there. Can't get bragged enough from the staff, they were so friendly, helpful and amazing. And the house is really on its own ""almost"" private beach. Walking distance to lots of cafes.

column2: >Our group had a wonderful short stay at Villa Celagi. The house managers were very knowledgeable and made great recommendations. The breakfasts were delicious and made to our liking. The location was perfect for our group (4 adults and 3 teens) and we enjoyed ocean swims on our door step!

Welcome to your home away from home! Villa Coral features 4 master suites all with private balconies, ocean views and exquisite ensuites.  If you’re looking for a homey family villa to accommodate up to 9 pax, Villa Coral makes an ideal choice.

Positioned on the beachfront in Tamarind Bay with clear views of Playgrounds and Lacerations surf breaks, you can paddle out for a surf, relax by the infinity pool, watch a movie in the games room, look out to Mt Agung from the upstairs alfresco lounge, enjoy a meal at the open air dining room, or have a relaxing drink around the poolside bar bale.
Snorkelling equipment and SUP boards are provide for your use.

column2: >This is a text to thank you for our wonderful accomodation at the coral Villa a week Avon it is a lovely villa , so well appointed , lovely decor, spacious and wonderful staff, especially Dwi. He was very professional, helpful and friendly. It’s in a great location.

>One complaint is the paddle boards had no leg strap so difficult to surf with , we also felt the villa should provide life jackets for use with the paddle board. It seems unfair to advertise that these are available but not in good condition. A kayak would also have been an added bonus.

column1: Exceptional house beach front. The place is sublime, what a view and how quiet! The infinity pool, the beach, the garden and amazing spaces outside as well as inside. With friendly staff who take care of meals. To book with your eyes closed.

column2: >This was our second stay at Villa Coral. Absolutely beautiful villa with the most receptive and friendly staff. Dwi and staff were very accommodating during our stay. Location is perfect, close to surf break, swim and sup at the front door. Can't wait to come back.

column1: Where to start...we had the best time in the most beautiful place. The location of the villa was excellent right between mushroom and coconut bay an easy walk or taxi ride to great restaurants and shops. The view across the beautiful blue waters to Mt Agung is spectacular. The villa was delightful with well thought out spaces. We were four couples and never did we feel we were overcrowded. The bedrooms were spacious all equal in size and great amenities. Being able to use the Villa Paddleboards and snorkeling equipment was an absolute bonus. The biggest compliment to this place is the wonderful staff that made our stay so enjoyable. They were amazing they cooked us delicious breakfasts each morning, tidied and refreshed the villa with big smiles. A special mention goes to Dwi who helped us with restaurant, taxi and excursion bookings. He was incredibly helpful and kind. I would highly recommend, I'm already planning my next trip to Villa Coral in 2025 :) Thanks for an amazing stay!!

column1: These 3 stunning villas offer you the perfect escape where you can check in to ""island time"" and discover the laid back village vibe of Nusa Lembongan.

column2: >This villa is absolutely stunning! It’s in a prime location and everything you want it to be for a open air luxury villa. We absolutely loved our stay here

column1: We had a lovely stay at the villa for our honeymoon. The staff was so friendly and helpful, it made everything feel super easy. The photos of the villas don’t really do them justice—ours was more spacious &amp
column2: beautiful than it looked in the photos. It’s also a great location on the island—really close to a couple restaurants and spas. The views of the bay are excellent, and you can even see a bit of ocean from the private pool. This place is definitely worth it.

>Great villa close to the beach and the ferry drop off point. Nice clean rooms and good air con. The villa was well equipped with pots and pans and the fridge stocked with drinks. Staff and communication with the team via email was honestly exceptional. They helped organise our transfers to and fro hotels and also the motorbike rental. Thank you to the team we had a lovely time

column1: We had a wonderful stay at tenang villas. The villa itself is beautiful, with stunning views over the bay. The location is perfect and very close to some good restaurants. The staff went above and beyond to make our stay relaxing and easy – our scooter broke down on Nusa Ceningan and they had a new one to us within 3 0mins! Couldn’t recommend highly enough!

column2: >The view of the beach from the villa was incredible. Satik and the whole team were amazing. They go the extra mile for customer satisfaction. I will safely say out of all the AirBnb’s I’ve stayed at, this place had the best staff/communication. They were so helpful to us, gave me rides, were always there whenever we needed and Satik showed me around the Island.  If you want an AirBnb where you are looked after, this is the one!!!

column1: Great place, great people, wonderful service and will come back again on my next visit to the island

column2: >We had such an amazing stay at Tenang villa. Satik and her team were fabulous, they collected us from our boat and were so helpful throughout the stay, they arranged activities, took us to the atm, booked our return boat back to Bali, they were fabulous!

column1: We had an amazing stay at Tenang Villas and highly recommend it. The four of us stayed at Villa 2 and everything was exactly as described and photographed. There was thoughtful touches throughout the villa like filtered water, plenty of toiletries, well stocked kitchen and a super cold fridge. The location was awesome with beautiful views and tons of local and international restaurants. The villa staff was super responsive, accommodating and welcoming. They happily arranged things for us like getting to/from the port and renting motorbikes for the duration of the stay. We will definitely stay here next time we’re here!

column2: >This place is such a treasure!! Beautiful view, beautiful villa, staff were SO helpful, great location, beds were super comfy, and the wifi was great. Highly recommended.

column1: I stayed two nights at the Tenang 2 Bedroom Villa and it's been just great.

column1: Villa Samudera is perfect for a romantic getaway for a couple looking for spaciousness and seclusion
column3: a group of mates hanging out, or for the family surfing holiday.

column1: Villa Samudera is an open plan design, blending Balinese, Javanese and contemporary elements. It is situated 200 metres from the beach down a sandy gang (lane) from Shipwrecks Surfbreak and Jungut Batu Beach. Nusa Lembongan is a tropical island paradise offering a place that is naturally rich in its environment, especially its surrounding tropical waters, and traditional Balinese heritage and culture.

Villa Samudera brings the outdoors inside, built with recycled Ulin (Ironwood) timber posts, beams and floorboards from Kalimantan, decorated with Antique teak javanese doors and wood panels. With the alang alang (thatched) grass roofing, high ceilings, and an open plan, the interior spaces stay cool making it a great place to retreat from the heat of the day. The only door to lock is the door to the garden entering the premises.

The living, kitchen and dining areas are completely open and feature stunning interiors from the Indonesian archipelago and the Asia region. There are two beautiful main bedrooms that have large king size beds with natural linens and a private bathroom each, separated from the open plan living space with romantic curtains that create a private retreat, when it is needed. Each room has views to the garden and pool.
The private rustic sleepout nestled in the garden beside the pool, provides a queen size bed and is a great place for a teen retreat or for hanging out by the pool.
Villa Samudera is a perfect relaxing space, designed for sharing and yet is spacious enough to ensure privacy.

We provide food basics including a self-serve Continental Breakfast of bread, milk, a selection of local tropical fruit, juice, spreads (honey, jam, peanut butter, and butter), Sumatran plunger coffee and selection of Lipton teas.
A fully cooked breakfast by our wonderful staff can be provided upon request (one day before) at 100,000 rupiah per head, paid directly to our staff.

Please note there is no Generator at the Villa and power outages are unpredictable on Nusa Lembongan.[/vc_column_text][/vc_tab][vc_tab title=""Rooms"" tab_id=""1421055594-2-62e001-77c573dc-238de8e0-b4c3""][vc_column_text]3 bedroom option

Perched on the beachfront of Jungutbatu, Nusa Lembongan, Ginger &amp
column2: Jamu is the island's home for honest, nourishing food made with genuine care. Open daily from 7:30am, it's the kind of place you find on your first morning and keep coming back to — for breakfast, for lunch, and more often than not, for dinner too.

column1: The menu is built around clean wholefoods with real flavour — nothing processed, no nasty oils, no shortcuts. Every dish is made fresh by hand using the highest quality local and regional ingredients sourced from Bali and the surrounding islands. Whether you're fuelling up before a dive, recovering after a surf, or settling in for a long lazy lunch with your toes in the sand, there's something on the menu that will hit the spot.
Plant-based and vegan guests are genuinely well catered for — not as an afterthought, but as a core part of the G&amp
column2: J philosophy. Smoothie bowls packed with colour and nutrition, vibrant avocado toasts, nourishing grain bowls, and a full menu of wholefood mains sit alongside options for omnivores, making it a rare spot where every guest at the table feels equally looked after.

column1: The coffee is organic, Indonesian-grown, and taken seriously. The juices and smoothies are cold-pressed and energising. The raw desserts are the kind that make you forget you're eating something good for you.

column2: Jamu is more than a café — it's a place where the food, the view, the team, and the energy of the island all come together. Come hungry, leave happy, and you'll be back before you know it.

column1: We wholeheartedly recommend staying at this magical villa. We felt so well looked after with wonderful service from Komang and the team. It was a very special experience to stay at Villa Lagarto. I look forward to our return.

column2: >We enjoyed staying at Villa Lagarto. Beautiful villa, nice swimming pool. Especially the staff, especially Komang, made our stay comfortable. Renting a scooter, other transportation, tips and advice
column3: everything went smoothly and pleasantly. Plenty of restaurants and breakfast places nearby. Dream beach became our favorite beach. Sandy Bay Beach club good restaurant with sweet staff.

column1: We had a fantastic stay at this villa! The location is great — peaceful yet close enough to everything we needed. The villa itself was very comfortable and had all the amenities we could ask for. From the moment we arrived at the pier, the staff was incredibly helpful, arranging transport and giving us a warm and smooth check-in with all the information we needed. Throughout our stay, the staff went above and beyond, helping us with laundry, motorbike rentals, and anything else we asked for. Their hospitality really made our trip even more enjoyable. The only minor downside was that one of the bathrooms near the pool had a bamboo wall, which didn’t offer much privacy. It wasn’t a major issue for us, but it’s worth noting. Overall, we really loved our time here and would definitely recommend it!

column2: >What a fantastic team of staff. I cannot speak highly enough of them. Beyond 5-star service with all of our requests. We felt very taken care of. A 2-minute walk to Sandy Bay Beach and restaurant. You can't beat that. The ocean view is gorgeous. The only thing is that the villas are quite close to each other and there are dogs that love to sing in the middle of the night so bring earplugs. Otherwise, I would stay again in a heartbeat.

Ohana’s (meaning “Family” in Hawaiian) is a Boutique Resort and Beach Club largely known as Lembongan’s premier venue for great vibes, sunsets, cocktails &amp
column2: dining – it is one of the island’s “must do’s”. Everything about Ohana’s has been designed as a place for people to make the most out of what Lembongan has to offer…laugh and make memories with family and friends.

column1: Ohana’s is located on the beach directly in front of Shipwrecks surf break in Jungut Batu village area.  Soak up the sun on the day beds, have a dip to cool down at the beautiful beach or if you prefer,  jump in our infinity pool. The venue looks out over the beach and crystal clear ocean – with its west-facing aspect it is the ideal location for watching the incredible sunsets that Lembongan has to offer.  The amazing new rooftop sunset lounge is a perfect location to take advantage of those magical moments.

The venue features sun lounges, day-beds and bean bags as well as casual dining both under cover and under the stars. Ohana’s is a great place to hang out during the day with complimentary use of both the family and beachfront infinity pool.  They have recently added an additional 10 rooms inclusive of two large family suites that all face the newly added large family pool with swim up ‘Aqua’ bar,  both available for guests and visitors

The food and beverage at Ohana’s has been designed by industry professionals to provide a carefully curated menu with a variety of items to suit travelers from around the world. Ohana’s prides itself on only using top quality ingredients and always delivering clean, healthy and incredibly tasty food and drinks.
To avoid disappointment, bookings are strongly recommended for day beds or dining.
Happy hours – 25% off cocktails and buckets of beer 3:00pm – 5:30pm daily.
Ohana’s gladly caters to large groups so please enquire or even better STAY at Ohana's Resort.

column2: Wine Shop, your go-to destination for a fantastic selection of local and imported wines, champagnes, and spirits. Our commitment to providing an extensive range of beverages ensures that you’ll find the perfect drink for any occasion, whether it’s a casual gathering, a romantic dinner, or a festive celebration.

Wine Shop, we pride ourselves on offering a diverse selection that includes bold red wines, refreshing white wines, sparkling champagnes, and a variety of unique spirits. We carefully curate our inventory to ensure that every bottle meets our high standards of quality and taste. Whether you're looking for something local or a well-known international brand, we have you covered.

column1: If you can’t find what you’re looking for, simply let us know! Our friendly and knowledgeable staff is always happy to assist you and can source specific products upon request, ensuring your favorites are always available.

For those staying in private villas, we offer a convenient pre-delivery service. Just contact us prior to your arrival, and we will arrange for your selected stock to be delivered and ready for you upon check-in. Imagine stepping into your villa with everything you need to unwind and enjoy your stay already in place—it's the perfect way to kick off your holiday.

column1: Ohana’s Boutique Resort and Beach Lounge is a luxury resort located on the beachfront in Nusa Lembongan’s main village of Jungut Batu. The resort occupies one of most prized locations on Nusa Lembongan being situated directly on the beach front in the main village of Jungut Batu.

Our resort flows onto the stunning white sands and the crystal clear water of the Indianan Ocean which is perfect for swimming and paddle boarding and further out in the water is surfing are the world class surf breaks of Shipwrecks and Lacerations surf break. We are surrounded by restaurants and coffee shops all within walking distance, not to mention our own world class beach lounge which is regarded as one of the top beach clubs in Bali - the perfect place to relax whilst on Nusa Lembongan!

There are not too many resorts in Indonesia (we cannot think of any) that enjoy the same mix of luxury in a beachfront location surrounded by restaurants and coffee shops, with calm crystal clear water on the doorstep that is perfect for swimming and world class surf breaks directly out the front of the resort.

We have incredible beachfront lounging and daybeds set on the beach and around our gorgeous pool for guests to enjoy. Chill out on the lawn or enjoy our undercover dining and lounging spaces. Our restaurant and bar serves incredible food from 7am till late.
The term “beach club” can be a little misleading in terms of the music as sometimes people think of a night club. The music is more like a vibrant restaurant level of music, not a night club.

The beach club plays music until close around 11pm most evenings, and maybe until mid-night at high season depending on how many guests are around, though the music is turned down gradually later in the evening.

Whilst our music is at a ""reasonable level"", and we are not a rave party or night club, often music can be heard from our rooms, especially the deluxe garden rooms, superior garden rooms and the 3-bedroom villa as they are located closest to the beach club. Many guests love our venue for its music and being connected to a vibrant atmosphere, though we understand this is not for everyone.
Our most quiet and luxurious hotel rooms at Ohana's are the ""Pool view suites"" and ""Junior pool view suites"" which overlook the resort pool and are furtherest away from the beach lounge.

If you are looking for a ""quiet, nature only"" experience whilst on Nusa Lembogan, then Ohana's resort is probably not the right place for you on this occasion and one of our luxury private villas at Aqua Nusa is a more suitable accommodation for you. Though the same applies for AQUA NUSA, as it is also near restaurants and night-life, so you may have music from nearby restaurants.

Unless staying outside of the main areas, anywhere in the more popular areas where there are restaurants will have noise and will likely not be perfectly quiet. It is the trade off for staying in the middle of the action on the beach front within walking distance to lots of restaurants, cafes and amenity.

Paws of Lembongan is a small community organisation which runs a sterilisation and treatment program for the dogs and cats on Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Ceningan. As it is not a common practice in Bali to neuter cats and dogs there are now large populations on the islands and unfortunately there are no veterinary services.

Paws of Lembongan was set up to provide a caring solution to the growing population problem through funding and organising vets to regularly attend the island and carry out sterilisations. The vets who we fund to come to the island also provide treatment, surgical procedures and medication for sick and injured animals. These essential services would not be possible without donations.
The local cats and dogs (some of which are pets and some live freely on the island) which are sterilised through Paws of Lembongan are also given vaccinations to keep them happy and healthy.
Paws of Lembongan is run by volunteers. We are entirely funded through donations with 100% of funding going to pay for supplies, medicines and for vets to come over from Bali.
We hope that through maintaining a constant program of veterinary services we can continue to care for the four legged community on Nusa Lembongan.

Hai Ri Zen is a brand new beachfront restaurant on Mushroom Bay and truly unique with its natural bamboo style architecture. Situated right on the beach the venue provides sweeping views of the turquoise blue ocean and the most spectacular sunsets Nusa Lembongan has to offer. There is no better place to watch the sun set over Mushroom Bay enjoying one of our handcrafted cocktails.

Hai Ri Zen is a “Small Plate Restaurant” allowing for choice and variety. As a guide the size of each serving is larger than a traditional entrée but smaller than the usual main course. Our award winning chef has created a mouthwatering fusion of classic Western and Asian cuisine with  something new every week.

Hai Ri Zen is more than just the new jewel of Nusa Lembongan, it is also the perfect wedding venue under the same management as Hai Tide Beach Resort. Our in-house wedding planner can provide a full service with reviews that speak for themselves.

The property is set on 2000m2 of lush tropical gardens and lawn which lead down to a white sandy and crystal clear waters beyond.

column1: Jipsi Beach House is the quintessential beach house that combines relaxed island life with subtle luxuries to ensure your holiday will be one you will never forget.
The beach front location, team of staff &amp
column2: stunning indoor and outdoor areas are the perfect place to soothe your soul.

column1: The main house has one master suite with king bed, the other bedroom has a queen bed with 2 bunk beds. This rooms sleeps 6 people.  The second master suite is joined to the main villa via a timber balcony.  The 4th bedroom is a bungalow style room with a queen bed, detached from the main house.

The living areas of the main villa has bifold doors with open up the villa onto the expansive timber deck for alfresco dining.  From here you can look out across the beautiful green lawns to the 10 x 5m pool, out door living pavilion and ocean.
The Jipsi Beach House team of staff are able to assist with your transport needs, scooter hire, snorkelling trips, restaurant bookings and other island activities.

column2: >We can’t rate the Jipsi Beach House highly enough. The house, grounds and views are stunning. Best of all were the staff who made our stay so relaxing and enjoyable. The meals were delicious and they went out of their way to help. A very memorable holiday, we hope to stay again.

column1: Peaceful and perfect. This beach house was a serene escape—quiet, relaxing, and exactly what my family needed. The layout of the house was fantastic: spacious, well thought-out, and made it easy to unwind. Would absolutely stay again if I went back to Nusa Lembongan.
