column15: }""][/bsf-info-box][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_tab][vc_tab title=""Description"" tab_id=""1421055594-1-76e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b0194ed3-29604f46-986a""][vc_column_text css=""""]If simply relaxing by the pool or on the beach is how you plan to spend your island getaway then White Horse Resort's beachfront location in Tamarind Bay has everything you need to make your stay perfect. However, If you want to soak up the local culture and see the amazing sights surrounding the retreat, Nusa Lembongan has plenty to offer.

column1: With gorgeous views of the pool from every room, choosing your accommodation is a breeze. Select from one of the four one-bedroom Villas or if you need more space, the two-bedroom Poolside or Upper Lodge is perfect for you.

Let your worries simply float away in the luxurious 20m private swimming pool. The overflow pool has a private swimout to each of the four boutique, two storey single villas. The Poolside Lodge boasts a separate 15m pool that cascades one metre into the long pool that is the stunning centrepiece of the four villas.

No need to worry about any pool sounds besides the splash of you diving in. All of the filtration and sanitising equipment is quietly located beneath the floor slabs with the large balance tanks. Salt water chlorination combined with ultra violet deactivation provides the ultimate in safe, healthy and sanitised swimming pool water.

Sit back and relax poolside with a refreshing drink from the refrigerated mini-bar in every villa. If you prefer to watch the sunset at the end of day down by the beach, grab a drink from the centrally located bar in the restaurant. You can choose from a full range of cocktails, wines and other beverages including freshly ground espresso coffee. Watch the sun go down with an Espresso Martini or dry Vodka Martini – shaken not stirred. Yes please!

Alongside the entry to the retreat from the beach, the Seaside Deck extends the entire length of the sea wall on the beach. Relax with your favourite book on one of the sun lounges or sip your favourite cocktail as you watch the sunset. Take your lunch to the deck and enjoy the sounds of the sea while enjoying one of our specially prepared meals.

A gourmet experience awaits you as our experienced chef prepares a delicious snack or meal from our extensive menu. Start your day with a full breakfast included with your room. All of our meals are prepared using sanitised, drinkable water.
Enjoy your lunch sitting poolside on your own private deck, in the beautiful restaurant or on the seaside deck overlooking Tamarind Bay. If only all choices were that simple.

White Horse Retreat is fully reticulated with filtered and UV sanitised water produced by an in-house desalination plant. The pure water is infused with sodium bicarbonate to raise the pH, the total alkalinity of the water and to improve the taste. Fresh, cool drinking water is readily available in reusable glass bottles.

The wood used in the Poolside Villas and the Poolside Lodge decks is all 30 year old recycled Ulin Ironwood. Labelled as the hardest wood in the world, it is extremely durable and will serve the White Horse Retreat well for the next 30 years.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tab][vc_tab title=""Rooms"" tab_id=""1421055594-2-62e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b0194ed3-29604f46-986a""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation=""""][vc_column_inner width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]Poolside Lodge

With sweeping views of the entire retreat, the Poolside Lodge is the epitome of luxury in paradise. It features two generously large, fully air conditioned bedrooms with equally spacious ensuites. The second bedroom can be configured as a king-size double bed or two king-size single beds.

The expansive central living area opens to the beautiful fresh sea breezes while ceiling fans help keep all rooms cool. The living area features all of the facilities you need to relax and enjoy your stay at the retreat, including a dining area and kitchenette with a large fridge and freezer. Unwind on the sun lounges on your own private sundeck. As its name suggests, the Poolside Lodge is nestled alongside the 15m pool, with direct access to and from the pool.

The beautiful Upper Lodge has grandiose wooden floors made from Ulin Ironwood. Echoing the design of the Poolside Lodge, it too is spacious with large rooms and ensuite. Open the central sliding door and enjoy the views of the retreat and ocean beyond. A poolside deck is available to use at the end of the long pool.

The four luxury, boutique Poolside Villas offer two storey opulence. Take in the gorgeous views from the spacious upper level balcony in comfortable chairs. The second storey bedroom features a stunning four poster bed with mosquito net. The ensuite is both spacious and beautifully appointed, with double vanities and extra-large shower. A kitchenette with full-size fridge/mini-bar is provided.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_tab][vc_tab title=""Location Map"" tab_id=""1421055855649-3-7e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b0194ed3-29604f46-986a""][vc_single_image image=""25719"" img_size=""large"" alignment=""center"" onclick=""img_link_large"" css="""" qode_css_animation=""""][vc_column_text]

column2: >A relaxing island escape with warm hospitality, stunning beachfront views and delicious food.

>From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed by Milu with a refreshing drink and a detailed introduction to the resort. The entire team at White Horse Resort were incredibly helpful throughout our stay—organising everything from scooters to explore the island, to snorkelling trips and relaxing in-house massages. Nothing was ever too much trouble. The food was another highlight—fresh, flavourful, and beautifully presented. I especially recommend the BBQ seafood plate—it was absolutely delicious! At low tide, we loved walking along the beach to explore nearby caves and watching the locals as they fished and searched for crustaceans.

column1: With 180 degree ocean views, soft coastal interiors, and four luxurious master suites, the 4-bedroom Beach Tonic villa is ideal for families or groups seeking space and serenity. Designed with natural textures and calming hues, it’s a retreat made for relaxation.
• Four master bedrooms with king beds (convertible to twins)
• Large pool deck with sun loungers and cabana
• Views of Mount Agung and Bali’s dramatic coastline
Whether you book 2, 3, or 4 bedrooms, the villa is exclusively yours—ensuring privacy and comfort at every turn.
[/vc_column_text][/vc_tab][vc_tab title=""Beach Tonic 2"" tab_id=""1745217944649-6-1""][vc_column_text css=""""]Beach Tonic 2: 2 Bedroom Villa

Tucked into the hillside with  ocean views, the private 2-bedroom villa brings together timeless design and modern ease. Thoughtful touches, natural tones, and open-plan living create a relaxed yet refined atmosphere.
• Two master bedrooms with king beds (convertible to twins)
• Private swimming pool with loungers and daybeds
Perfect for couples or small families looking to unwind, explore, and experience the best of Nusa Lembongan at their own pace.
Solid costal vibes in a tranquil setting.

Stunning coastal vibe that are very very zen, private, views are great (although you can’t see the sunset directly), bar a washing machine/tv it’s appointed well enough to live in long term. Staff are all amazing and super friendly. Special shout out to Lonjong.

column2: ><em>Beach Tonic is absolutely beautiful. Everything exceeded our expectations. Wonderful breakfast included.

>Beautiful clean villa. Photos don’t do this place justice. Absolutely stunning view of the bay. Staff are super attentive, caring and always go above and beyond. Lonjong Villa Manager is a fantastic asset. 10 stars!

column1: Fabulous week at Tonic. Staff and amenities excellent. Great Location. Would absolutely recommend.

column2: >Above and beyond in every way! We loved our stay at this villa on Nusa Lembongan. It was private and clean, and walking distance from everything you could need. The absolute best part was the staff who made us feel so welcome, made incredible breakfasts every morning (seriously the best!), and were so responsive. They went so far as to hand deliver something we had forgotten to our ferry! We stayed with our two kids and given the pool and balcony were a little concerned. Fortunately each bedroom locks from the outside which was helpful for safety. The entrance to the villa is up a flight of stairs (about 80 steps). We did it multiple times a day with kids and weren’t bothered. There are two great beaches, countless restaurants, and a wonderful spa all within a 10 minute walk. We would recommend this home in a heartbeat.

column1: Beautiful little villa on Lembongan. the pool is small, but big enough for the kids to splash around and adults to have a dip. Spectacular view across the beach and for sunset. great air con in all bedrooms with lovely bathrooms. the staff were super helpful and made lovely breakfasts 😊 only thing to be aware of is there's lots of steps up to the villa. The staff carried out bags on arrival and departure, but wouldn't be suitable if you were frequently taking a pram or had mobility issues. otherwise would recommend, and would happily stay here again!

Beach tonic was an amazing place . We had a fantastic stay. The team there were amazing people . Long John and his staff were so helpful and friendly. I highly recommend staying at beach tonic if you get the chance.

column2: >Spent 5 nights here with a group of friends in July. This villa is beautiful with some of the best views in Lembongan. Very comfortable beds and huge ensuite. Lonjong was incredibly helpful, organising laundry, snorkelling trips, scooters and our ferry back to Bali. The rest of the team (Manda, Gede and Erna) could not be faulted! Thanks for a great stay.

column1: Beach Tonic was a very private, intimate, luxury villa.
The staff was extremely professional and well spoken.

column2: >We had a wonderful stay at Beach Tonic. The staff were incredible, the villa is simply stunning, well appointed, and the views were to die for. It is well located and we were able to walk to the beach and many restaurants, or easily catch a taxi anywhere else. We had two families with four kids (ages 6-12). Could not recommend more highly.

column1: Stunning villa big enough to fit our family of 8 comfortably. The views are amazing and the staff were just so lovely. Breakfast each morning was delicious. Nothing too much trouble for Lonjong and his team. We can’t wait to go back!

column2: >We loved our stay at Beach Tonic. The Villa is perfectly located, with great views and within walking distance of amenities and hot spots. A big thank you to accommodating, friendly and vibrant staff who made us feel right at home.

column1: Our week-long stay at the villa was exceptional. The breathtaking views, outstanding staff, and exquisite breakfasts exceeded expectations. We highly recommend this property.

The second Sunday of every month, The Coconut Hut is host to the Lembongan Community Market, where residents can showcase their fresh produce, hand made goods, or locally sourced items.
Our little island community has become extremely resourceful in the last few months, and we now have available some fantastic organic fruit &amp
column2: vegetables, raw organic honey, locally produced virgin coconut oil, just to name a few. It’s a fantastic way to support these beautiful people, while shopping for the items you need.

column1: With tourism being the islands main source of income, the effects of COVID-19 completely devastated our island community, but with creative resilience and sheer determination we have seen waitresses become sewers, DJ’s become farmers, villa managers become cooks, and even barmen become artists. This is a place where our community comes together to support one another with open arms, and nothing but good vibes.

Koa Donuts was established in June 2020, supplying home made sweet treats to visitors to Nusa Lembongan, order from your villa, resort or bungalow and we will deliver to you!

We also have shop on Jungutbatu - Indiana Kenanga Gang. Open daily 7am-6pm with fresh donuts, vegan banana cake, vegan carrot cake, bombolonies, coffees hot or ice, cookies, and many more! we also can make your dreaming birthday cake, special for anniversary or any other special day!
Locally owned and operated we are dedicated to providing the island with delicious  donuts, cakes and cookies.

The product list includes mini and premium donuts all topped with icing and delightful extras.  Koa Donuts also specialise in birthday cakes made to order, vegan banana and carrot cakes plus vegan oatmeal cookies. We are dedicated to using premium ingredients and expanding our product list, send us a what's app if you have any special requests.  We will do our best to help you satisfy your sweet cravings!

Island favourites are the vegan banana cake and mix packet of donuts with various toppings.  We cater for special events, birthdays and anniversaries - we can make something special and personalised for your occasion.

Make your stay on Nusa Lembongan one to remember, with some delicious donuts, the perfect way to complete a day of island adventures and fuel up for tomorrow's plans whether it be diving, snorkelling, surfing, yoga or simply relaxing by the pool.
Please be sure to order in advance as we sell out quickly, we need 24 hours notice.
One bite and you will be back for more!!

48254,"THE ISLAND FRESH","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""full_width"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" css_animation="""" background_color=""#00a79d""][vc_column][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""][vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='40px' up='' down='']

The Island Fresh Nusa Lembongan is a fantastic provider of organic fresh produce, located in Jungut Batu and dedicated to stocking products for those with dietary needs and those looking for healthy options.

We supply vegetables and fruit grown on an organic farm in Bedugul, near Mt Kintamani in Bali, ensuring the best seasonal produce is stocked. This gives island visitors the opportunity to purchase fresh ingredients that were previously not available in Nusa Lembongan.

Our mission is to support health and conscious living, which extends to our range of Bulk Foods, including superfoods, seeds, dry herbs, nuts, quinoa, dates, cloves, goji berries, and cooking powders. Please bring your own containers, or there is an option to purchase reusable ones.

We also offer a great range of vegan snack options, including vegan chocolate, vegan cookies, tempeh chips, cassava chips, healthy granola, and rice crackers. Plus, gluten-free products such as pasta, noodles, and bread are available.
For those preferring non-dairy options, we stock almond, soy, and coconut milk.
Health is our mantra, and our drinks selection includes immune boosters, kombucha, herbal infusions, water kefir, prebiotic drinks, and instant or homemade jamu.
New products are always arriving, and we recently started stocking locally made honey from Java.

For those who love to cook, you'll find a great selection of kitchen spices at The Island Fresh. We also offer private cooking services, perfect for those wanting to experience healthy, home-cooked meals made with our organic ingredients.
FREE delivery is available for all orders—please place your order at least 24 hours in advance, as our product lists and availability are updated daily.
Please note: We accept card payments only (no cash).

[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

White Corner Coffee Shop is a locally family owned business perfectly located on the shores of Jungutbatu.  Start your day with breakfast while your feet are in white sand and eyes gazing at turquoise waters, drop in for lunch between island adventures or perhaps end it with dinner watching Lembongan’s famous sunsets.
Our menu offers options to feed your soul from morning to night and clear days we even include views of Mt Agung!
Located at the base of “the hill” we are your one stop shop for great coffee, delicious food and ice cold bintangs.

White Corner Coffee Shop has a great range of food and drinks for everyone.  Come and spend the day working using our FREE WiFi on a shaded deck, watch the surf at Lacerations or enjoy a SUP board on the beautiful waters of Jungutbatu Bay.
Come visit us on your next stay on Lembongan or we will be more than happy to deliver to you at no charge in Jungutbatu village.

Scuba Center Asia – The Ultimate Dive Experience

Staying in a dreamy island villa on Nusa Lembongan? Make your holiday truly unforgettable by diving with Scuba Center Asia! We’re not your average dive center. We are the island’s most trusted, professional, and personal dive resort.

As a PADI 5★ IDC Dive Resort with a world-class reputation, Scuba Center Asia isn’t just another dive shop, it’s where your journey as a diver begins in style. From the moment you arrive, you’ll feel the difference: personalized service, small groups, relaxed island vibes, and instructors who genuinely care about making your first dive safe, smooth, and sensational.

Never dived before? No worries. We love teaching beginners and we do it differently. Small groups. Chill vibes. Safety first, always. But most of all: we make sure you have fun and feel 100% comfortable. Because diving should never be rushed, or boring.

And the dive sites? Unreal. Warm, clear water. Turtles, corals, manta rays, and if you are really lucky, sometimes even a mola mola! All that, just a short boat ride away around our beautiful Nusa Penida Marine Park.
If you’re looking for the best dive experience on the island, Scuba Center Asia is your go-to. Professional, passionate, and just a few sandy steps away from your villa.

Morin has two boats and a wide range of possible adventures to choose from.

Ocean Adventures by Morin speedboat, named Pari Manta, offers a fully private transfer between Sanur and Lembongan. Choose your preferred time and speed, while enjoying the beauty of the ocean. In Sanur, their team will meet you at Mertasari Harbour, on the jetty. In Lembongan, you will arrive on the beach at Tamarind Bay or Jungut Batu village.
With Pari Manta, you can also plan a trip to swim with the manta rays, relax on the boat for a sunset cruise or head to the Gili islands.

Morin also offers one-day escapes from Bali, for those of you who would love a full ocean and island day but be back on Bali by sunset. You may choose the Island Goddess Escape to spend the day in the ocean and on Lembongan with your girlfriends
column2: the Surfer Escape, surfing Lembongan’s most famous surf spots followed by other water activities
column3: or the Nature Lover, learning about marine conservation and practical ways of getting involved.

column1: The play boat, named Ikan Terbang, is best suited from near-by snorkeling adventures, waterski, wakeboard, kneeboard or a romantic escape with your favourite person in the world.

column1: 51157,"BALI DIVING ACADEMY","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

Bali Diving Academy in Lembongan is a 5 star PADI IDC Center with 100 % safety record .We are located directly on the beach in beautiful Lembongan Bay , where we have our own pool to teach courses in a safe and controlled manner, situated inside the grounds of Bungalow No 7.

Diving in Nusa Lembongan, or its much greater sister Nusa Penida, can be amazing. The Nusas, as they are familiarly called there, are a unique experience. It is almost certain you will be able to dive with Mantas Alfredi (aka Reef Mantas). It is amazing to observe them all year round flying above cleaning stations or performing a mating train.

Besides mantas, we try to bring our customers to not overly crowed dive sites but still with high chance of encountering Mola Alexandrini (aka Mola Mola aka sun fish). From June to October, they are coming from the depths to feed, mate and get cleaned by the reef fishes.

The coral reefs are stunning with a huge diversity of hard and soft corals. Massive bommies and gigantic table corals are very common there. The macro lovers will also enjoy the diversity of little critters like nudies, frogfishes, etc. The visibility can range from 5m to immeasurable depending on the conditions.
We usually go out with our boat 2 – 3 times a day. Early morning for 1 dive, and mid morning for 2 dives with lunch between dives. Schedule is variable depending on tides and daily activities.
- All PADI courses to get certified
All our packages / dive trips include snorkeling or dive equipment, professional dive guide / instructor, community contribution and no hidden cost!
We have a strong focus on Marine Biology programs.

Our in-house Marine Biologist is in charge of our exclusive Dive Master + Marine Biology Training Program. We collaborate with 2 local organizations that are focused in reef restoration, reef conservation and education: Coral Cousins &amp
column2: Nuansa Pulau Community of Nusa Penida.

column1: We also train future PADI instructors in Lembongan.

Amongst the idyllic, seaside village of Nusa Lembongan, Spring Spa and Sanctuary boasts azure blue sea views of Mt Agung. Barefoot luxury at its best, the property sets new benchmarks in wellness on the island.

The spa menu has been designed for clients to enter our world of slow island living with personalised treatments carried out by expert hands. Open-air treatment huts with breath-taking views are cocooned from the crowds. Signature treatments are regionally inspired, using locally grown, green, and ethically sourced katoni seaweed. With a menu that includes Spring’s famed massages, facials, and body treatments, the sanctuary’s main pavilion includes manicure and pedicure stations and a hair spa.
• 8 individual luxurious therapy villas with outdoor ensuites, built from recycled teak and local Lembongan stone set in over 2000sqm landscaped gardens.
• A large reception pavilion with 8 treatment pods, hair spa, bar, and relaxation area overlooking the water.
• Private buggy service exclusively for Spring Spa patrons.
• Environmentally conscious, using mostly local elements, all villas are made from recycled teak and outdoor bathrooms from local stone.
• Located on millionaire mile, Spring Spa and Sanctuary is located a stone’s throw away from “The Deck”, Coconuts Beach and Batu Karang Hotel

dawn by Lago is a lively grab-and-go café located right on Coconut Beach, offering specialty coffee, fresh juices, Aperol and beer on tap, signature DAWN canned cocktails, wholesome bites, and house-made pastries from early morning through late afternoon. With its relaxed island aesthetic, it’s ideal for pre-surf fuel, a beachside coffee stop, or a light lunch to take away. As part of the Lago hospitality family, dawn blends quality ingredients, friendly service, and an effortless Bali vibe.

Perched above the soft sands of Coconut Beach in Nusa Lembongan, dusk by Lago is a refined seaside bistro where island ease meets elevated dining. As the sun begins to dip, the space comes alive with uninterrupted views, and a relaxed yet sophisticated atmosphere. Expect a vibrant, creative menu and thoughtfully crafted cocktails, all served against the backdrop of gentle waves and golden hour skies.

Pontoon by Lago is a unique floating oasis and meeting point for adventure seekers and ocean lovers, offering crafted cocktails, floating sun loungers, and stunning views of the Indian Ocean and sunset. Powered by solar panels with its own water filtration system, this eco-conscious retreat provides a front-row seat to the Playgrounds surf break. Guests can enjoy activities like plunging from the jumping tower or simply relaxing in the sun while enjoying the Happy Hour from 4 PM to 5.30 PM every day.
• Offer: Buy 2 get 1 free (on the same cocktail)
Pontoon by Lago is also available for private events with customizable packages and complimentary boat shuttle from dawn.

Seek out the ultimate hideaway of peace and tranquility at The Sundeck by Lago. Enjoy refreshing dips in the plunge pool or unwind with a session in the sauna before relaxing on one of our sunbeds overlooking the beautiful Playgrounds surf break.

This gives the villa a genuine island feel and exudes a romantic touch and brings our guests into a tropical idyll so close to this stunning Sandy Bay beach.
You will be immersed in nature and revel in the surrounds as you are able to have the villa completely open to sleep virtually under the stars and hear the waves crashing onto Devils Tear.
The villa concept always embraced the outdoors and as such the large Bale built at the end of the pool creates another living space to enjoy.
For those looking for more seclusion the villa can be closed up with curtains drawn and the air-conditioning on giving you the option to relax in the comfort of indoors.

The ‘Shanty’ is only 50 metres away from Nusa Lembongan’s famous Sandy Bay Beach Club.  Enjoy delicious meals and incredible cocktails throughout the day and into the evening whilst you watch Mother Nature’s sky show as the sun sets.
The villa is fully staffed, offering a daily house keeping service and completed with subtle luxuries to ensure a relaxing stay at the wonderful Sea Shanty.

column2: >Amazing stay, will be back, best spot on the island, amazing staff.

column1: Great hosts, the team looking after the villa are really nice and in touch via prior to ensure we had a precooked taxi to collect us from the boat. The villa was really nice with all the amenities as listed. They have a cleaning services everyday to tidy the garden and sweep the villa. The pool is fabulous and great after a long hot day. The fridge is restocked with beer and soft drinks which you pay for when you leave. Location of our villa was right next to Sandy bay beach club but there are other places to eat and small shop up the road.

column2: >We loved our stay at Sea Shanty!
><em>The villa was amazing – very clean, spacious and comfortable. The location is quiet and peaceful, with the sounds of nature all around
column3: at night you can even hear the ocean. The villa has two air conditioners and two ceiling fans, so you can easily adjust the temperature on each side for maximum comfort. There is also a large fridge with a minibar (for a fee) and a freezer, which was very convenient. The manager, Komang, was exceptionally kind and helpful – he arranged a scooter for us, took care of our laundry (ready the next day!), and was always attentive and supportive. Just keep in mind that the island does not have its own water source, so showering is slightly limited. In our case, the water stopped after a minute or so, but it started running again after a short pause, so it was never really a problem. Overall, we truly loved our stay at Sea Shanty and would be happy to come back!

column1: Very happy with our stay! Great communication and we loved our accommodations!

column2: >The villa manager, Kormang, was delightful. Helpful in every way and always responsive to messages or requests. Right next to the Sandy Bay Beach club, which was a bonus as it's a beautiful spot for a drink or a meal. Very quiet at night, no through traffic, plenty of space and a good sized pool. Our first trip to Lembongan and truly a little piece of paradise.

column1: This was by far the most beautiful Airbnb on our entire Bali trip! The accommodation was very clean, beautifully furnished and located in a fantastic environment. The service was great and thanks to the organisation of The Lembongan Traveller, the journey by boat was also totally uncomplicated. We felt completely comfortable here and would come back at any time – absolutely recommended!

column2: >The villa was absolutely great, exactly as described. Komang was very helpful thoroughly enjoyed our 3 nights.

column1: A perfect stay at this stunning villa. Upon arrival at the port of Mushroom Bay, we were waiting. They called us the taxi. When we opened the garden door we were excited, were greeted by the wonderful team with orange juice and wet towel and they explained everything to us. We felt really good. The villa is a rare gem and I understand why now. Private with our pool, our large patio was the dream place for my wife's 30th birthday. For an extra fee, because I wanted something wow for the party day. They prepared the decorations in the room, sparkling wine and cake and confetti. That was awesome. I highly recommend this villa and the hosts the Lembongan travel they are wonderful. Thank you for everything, it will remain in our memory forever.

column2: >It was a very enjoyable stay. We felt comfortable because the villa offers a lot of privacy. Our host helped us with transportation on the island and was very friendly. We would stay there again anytime.

column1: We had a wonderful stay in Nusa Lembongan in the Shanty villa. The villa is absolutely perfect for a few days and even exceeded our expectations. The staff were very attentive to all our needs and even allowed us to organise activities and babysitting services. One regret: not staying longer. Thank you for everything!!!

column2: >We had such a great stay!! The villa was beautiful and we loved the location just steps away from the beach!

Located on the cliff at the east end of Tamarind Beach, The Playful Table is unlike any other restaurant on Nusa Lembongan, in fact it is far more than a restaurant, it’s an experience!

At The Playful Table we are all about connection, creativity, and inspiration. Connect to yourself, to your friends, your family, connect back to nature, and have a delicious meal prepared and served with love and intention. On a quiet section of Jungut Batu Beach, the Tigerlillys Beach Shack brings the vibe of Tigerlillys Boutique Hotel to the water. Trade the flowing palms for tumbling waves and epic sunsets as you gather with friends and family over refreshing cocktails and delicious eats. The Beach Shack sits on the edge of soft golden sands, welcoming you every day from 8am.

Spend the day under the umbrellas on our cozy lounges, or get some work done in our restaurant while enjoying our fast fibre optic internet. Our brunch, lunch and dinner offerings will help you keep the beach day rolling, including a dedicated section for our vegetarian and vegan guests.

Happy Hour everyday is based around sunset, which means you get to enjoy our best drinks and best views for less. Gather with your travel buds, partners and family to say goodbye to another magical day on Nusa Lembongan and welcome in the evening.

column2: Beach BBQ's are just a few of the ways we aim to provide the best beach experience on the island. Movie nights bring modern faves and classics to Jungut Batu every Wednesday, Friday's are all about amazing local live music acts to get you up off your seat and dancing on the sand. Sundays evolve around sunny afternoons, great friends, funky music and an epic BBQ cooked up by our grill master Thomy.

column1: If you’re looking for a laid back spot to keep an eye on the little ones as you nurse a coffee or smoothie bowl, then you’ll feel right at home. The Beach Shack offers a kid-friendly space with a playground on the sand, toys to play with and, of course, the kindest staff in Nusa Lembongan. Kick back, catch up on work with our fast free WiFi and let us handle the rest!

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_tabs style=""boxed""][vc_tab title=""Description"" tab_id=""1421055594-1-76e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b0197b19-fb3a""][vc_column_text]Villa Katoni is located on a small cliff with direct and private access to a secret beach, overlooking the quiet lagoon and it's scenic seaweed farms. Villa Katoni Lembongan - named after the very seaweed you will contemplate, offers you a unique slow living experience during your visit to the Island of Gods. Let the light sea breeze and the distant sound of the waves on the coral reef gently rock you and slow living invade you.

Villa Katoni is designed around three en-suite bedrooms and one bedroom for youngsters, a large infinity pool, a roof terrace prefect for your yoga practice, a local massage and relaxation, plus no less than three other dedicated outdoor places: alang alang pergola, sunken with a fire pit and a beach deck - where you can enjoy breakfast, lunch, dining, work, relax and chill while enjoying the Indian Ocean view.

Ideal for family gatherings of 8, Katoni has three staff to help you during your stay, they will prepare complimentary breakfast and organise lunch or dinner should you wish to dine at the villa. They will also organise transport pickup, motorbike rental, lunch and dinner home delivery, snorkelling trips and plenty other island activities. Katoni offers free WIFI, security through outdoor CCTV system,  Marshall/Sonos sound system for easy listening, active energy saving practices through the solar panel system and sound environment practices through waste management (compost, plastic, cardboard)
Villa Katoni Lembongan is available for a stay of 2 nights minimum and offers special rates for for stays of six nights or more.

The large open sun deck, bordered by a 22 meter infinity pool, takes full advantage of the ocean view with manta rays,  turtles and dolphins swimming around right in front of you!

The master suite is set up with a double (king size) bed and a bath tub with ocean view.
Bedroom number three can be configured to a family suite with a single king size bed and four kids bunk bed.

You can do as little or as much as you wish, all the time being looked after by our villa manager, Mr. Topik, and his friendly and attentive team.The Shambala Villa is one of the newest villas on Lembongan and offers all you would expect from a luxury villa, Book now and let’s make your dream holidays come true!

column1: 56959,"ZIPLINE CENINGAN","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""full_width"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" css_animation="""" background_color=""#00a79d""][vc_column][vc_empty_space][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]

KOV on the stunning Nusa Ceningan Island offers an adventure that’s not to be missed: the Zipline Ceningan experience! Nestled amidst lush greenery and sparkling blue waters, KOV Ceningan is a paradise for thrill-seekers and nature lovers alike. The resort’s exhilarating 100-meter-long zipline ride promises an unforgettable way to experience the island’s beauty, offering breathtaking views of the lush landscapes, cliffside shores, and surrounding turquoise seas. As you soar through the air, feel the wind rush past and enjoy the unique perspective that only a zipline can provide.

The zipline is designed for everyone—from solo travelers looking for a bit of adrenaline to couples and families wanting to share a special moment together. It’s a fantastic activity to bond over, and it’s safe for kids, too, so no one has to miss out. Bring your camera along because you’ll want to capture every thrilling moment from start to finish. You’ll find yourself reaching for those pictures again and again, reliving the excitement long after you’re back home.

Once your feet are back on solid ground, take advantage of KOV’s other fantastic amenities. Treat yourself to a delicious meal at the onsite restaurant, where an array of refreshing drinks and delectable dishes awaits, all served with a side of stunning ocean views. For those seeking a bit more relaxation, head to the infinity pool and let yourself unwind. Stretch out under the warm sun, soak in the serene atmosphere, and gaze out over the endless expanse of water.
Located just a short walk from the iconic yellow bridge that connects Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Ceningan, KOV Ceningan and its zipline should be at the top of your travel itinerary.

At Morin Resort you will enjoy a deep healing sleep, and wake up to breathtaking ocean views. Our boutique suites offer the perfect balance of comfort, elegance, and chilled island vibes.

Designed to feel playful, adventurous and carefree, Morin Resort is a heritage boutique hotel run like a home, where everyone feels like family. We offer a range of rooms and suites all designed with flair, creativity and authenticity. Located on the most secluded and peaceful side of Nusa Lembongan, we are within a 3-minute walk to two beaches.
Morin Resort is built on the foundation and connections that have grown from three decades of Lembongan life between two families: the Monoh from Nusa Lembongan and the Jamar from Belgium.
The name Morin comes from the Mooring Buoy, the anchoring point used to moor boats. The “Mo” from Morin also celebrates Made Monoh, the land owner and keeper.
We designed Morin Resort as a place:
-to connect to yourself, to your friends and family
-to discover and protect the natural world of our fragile island

Morin Resort is dedicated to creating magical experiences, sharing the warmth and beauty of our cultures, and to being caring stewards of this island and the ocean that surrounds it. It is our honor to call Nusa Lembongan home, to host people from all over the world, and to share the essence of this tropical paradise.

Morin Resort is a beautiful quiet resort with lovely staff and delicious food.
The wonderful friendly staff, beautiful views and rustic luxury.

column2: >Breakfast was amazing when we arranged in room breakfast. Loved the staff.

column1: Intimate resort with rustic-style modern and clean rooms with sensational views over the ocean. Close to two great beaches for swimming and snorkelling. Friendly and helpful staff Lovely food Stunning pool area.

column2: >Incredible! We had a great time. The resort is complete and very beautiful as in the photos! The staff is great! I'd come back!

column1: Our stay at Morin resort went extremely well. The view from the bedroom is breathtaking. The pool is lovely and the staff are super welcoming. We'll be happy to come back if we pass through Nusa Lembongan again.

column2: >We had an absolutely extraordinary stay in villa no. 1. Its location is simply exceptional, offering a unique and unforgettable setting. But what made our stay even more enjoyable was the presence of Eka: always smiling, caring, available at any time and a valuable help in all situations. She really made every moment of our holiday easier and allowed us to fully enjoy this magical place, with complete peace of mind. A huge thank you to the owner and Eka for this memorable experience. We recommend this villa without a second thought and will be happy to come back!

column1: So nice to stay at Morin. It is highly recommended

column2: >My stay at Morin was nothing short of magical from start to finish. ✨ The walk to the beach felt unreal, the food was incredible, the staff beyond kind, and even the music added to the magic. We arrived with a bad case of Bali belly and barely made it, but the team welcomed us with hydration and soup that truly helped us recover. The room was so cozy with a beautiful view, and even the other guests at the resort were warm and friendly. The birds were playful. it’s hard to put into words, but the whole experience was pure magic. If you ever have the chance, stay here you won’t regret it! 🌿🕊️

column1: Morin is absolutely beautiful and has the nicest staff. Truly professional and lovely. The view is unbeatable and it was such a unique experience. The only thing to note is that it is a bit further away from the main beach areas than I would like. Coconut beach is right next door, so if you’re looking for a bit of privacy away from the main area, this is perfect for you.

column2: >Relaxing, personal, modern with an eye for authenticity. The small scale and the spontaneity. You could ask the staff anything.

column1: Beautiful location, great food, morning yoga, views and staff. Location and staff and pool.

column2: ><em>Our stay at Morin Resort was exceptional from the very first moment. The level of service here is truly top-tier
column3: the staff were brilliant throughout our visit-unfailingly polite, attentive, and always happy to help with a warm smile. We stayed in one of the pool villas, and it was absolutely incredible. Having our own private pool felt like a true luxury, and the villa itself was beautifully designed, spacious, and immaculately clean. It was our own private sanctuary to return to each day. The resort's main facilities are just as impressive. The restaurant served delicious food with a great atmosphere, and the main pool area is stunning and a fantastic place to unwind. For me, the perfect way to begin each morning was on the yoga deck, which offers a serene and beautiful space to practice. The entire resort has such a wonderfully relaxing atmosphere. To top it all off, the location is perfect, with major attractions just a pleasant walk away. We left feeling completely refreshed and can't wait to return.

column2: >Amazing experience. Amazing location and staff. Great breakfast.

Once you step through the meticulously handmade Bali limestone walls you will sense the peace and tranquility of this beautifully designed and crafted villa. Continuing down the white bougainvillea shaded boardwalk leads you past the discretely hidden bedrooms behind slatted timber sliding screens acting as both a privacy barrier and a welcoming breezeway.
Designed to blend with nature, the Kokomo aesthetic incorporates recycled timbers, teak floors and the timber screening provides both privacy and ventilation.

Sliding back the screen reveals the master bedroom surrounded by garden with a beautifully styled ensuite featuring an outdoor rain shower. The luxurious king size bed and suspended mosquito net draped from the vaulted ceiling provide a perfect retreat for blissful rest.

The guest bedroom gives you the option to set up with either twin beds or a super-king size bed. The spacious outdoor bathroom continues the integration of the warmth of timber with earthy tones and a beautiful open air stone shower wall.

Continue down the boardwalk into the stunning open air living space featuring dramatic recycled Ulin timber beams and a soaring traditional alang alang roof. You can cook up a storm in the fully fitted out kitchen with locally sourced produce or popped over to Sandy Bay Beach Club for all day dining and amazing cocktails.

The living area is fitted with the latest large screen Smart TV and Bluetooth sound bar for fully immersive sound. For those who like to stay connected, Kokomo is equipped with Starlink satellite internet offering speeds up to 140 Mbps — perfect for remote work, streaming, or sharing your island getaway in real-time.
All rooms are fitted with fans and the master and guest bedrooms are fully air conditioned.
The pool is a Lakeman tile masterpiece featuring a restful, calming waterfall making your daybed dreaming all the more relaxing.

Located in beautiful Sandy Bay, Kokomo is a mere 30 metres from both the secluded white sand beach and the renowned Sandy Bay Beach Club, a true paradise at your doorstep. You are also within walking distance of many traditional restaurants [warungs] serving the best the island has to offer.

column1: 57728,"CAPTAIN YIN YANG","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

Captain Yin Yang was established in 2022 by Komang Arnaya we are a small local owned business. The name comes from the Yin Yang that was on the first Jukung (traditional wooden) boat that started the business.
Captain Komang and his team are all born and bred in Nusa Lembongan.
The team have grown up in the ocean from learning to surf as children and fish with their fathers. Their knowledge of the waters around the Nusa islands has been passed down by generations.

Komang has spent his life on the ocean from surfing and fishing as a young boy to working as a life guard and dive master before starting his own business. Komang is a well known very experienced Captain and guide around the Nusa Islands with over 15 years experience.

The highlights of the snorkeling trips are the Manta Rays that can be seen year round, (condition depending) there is also a very healthy coral reef system with an abundance of tropical fish and turtles found at various sites around Nusa Penida and Lembongan.

Captain Yin Yang offers private tours and shared boat tours which are family friendly and custom designed to suit your group. First Aid and safety equipment is included on board plus all snorkeling equipment.
Our team of Captains and guides will entertain you with their Balinese charm! We can't guarantee the weather or the marine life but we can guarantee a good time!
Nusa Lembongan is a small island located 45 minutes by Fast ferry from Sanur. We are located on Song Lambung Beach (Coconut Beach) but pick up can be arranged from anywhere in Bali.

58263,"JETSKI LEMBONGAN ADVENTURE","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']
WELCOME TO JETSKI LEMBONGAN ADVENTURE, the ultimate island hopping experience !
Ride your own Jetski and explore Lembongan, Penida and Ceningan highlight's in a fun way! All our tours are guided with a professional captain.

There are 4 guided safari tour options to give you the opportunity to explore the islands in your own favourite way. During the trip, participants typically follow a guide who leads the group to different locations of interest, highlighting points of natural beauty or simply providing a fun and exhilarating experience on the water.

Our safaris include stops at scenic spots like YELLOW BRIDGE, CRYSTAL BAY, BROKEN BEACH, KELINGKING BEACH, brief breaks for swimming on secret beaches, and opportunities to observe wildlife (especially dolphins or manta ray) or landmarks along the route.

Depending on your wishes and levels, you could choose the ride fitting with your expectations: focus on sightseeing or be more adventurous with high-speed rides, simply discover the pleasure of the activity or enjoy the sunset from the sea. Always with safety measures, for all the rides we provide life jacket, goggles, cloves, shoes and follow local boating regulations, to ensure a secure and enjoyable experience. All our jetskis are brand new (Seadoo GTX Pro 130, 1.630cc).

Nusa Lembongan, Ceningan and Penida are stunningly beautiful destinations with plenty to offer for anyone who loves natural beauty. And there’s no better way to explore these islands than with Jetski Lembongan Adventure. From crystal clear waters to colourful coral reefs, stunning rock formations, and white sandy beaches, there’s something for everyone on these islands.

Our crafted safari packages - Blue Lagoon Ride, Fun Ride, Island Escape, Penida Pulse and Full Trip - blend excitement, enjoyment, and wonder. Bring back wonderful photos of your experience captured by your guide during your ride.
Contact us and get some more explanation about our ways to ride through the islands and have FUN !!

Nestled in the heart of Jungut Batu, Nusa Lembongan, Tigerlilly's Cafe is a true hidden gem waiting to be discovered.

The beauty of Tigerlilly's Cafe, located within the wall of Tigerlillys Boutique Hotel, lies not only in its tasty food offerings, but also in its enchanting setting. You’ll find yourself surrounded by lush green gardens with sunlight peeking through the trees.

Start your day with our delicious brunch menu, boasting Acai bowls, Shashuka, Avocado toast and the Big Breakfast. Paired with espresso coffee, tea or cold pressed juice, it’s a delightful way to begin your day on the island.

Need to get some work done? Tigerlilly's Cafe offers perhaps the fastest internet on the island, with fibre optic connectivity up to 45 mbps. Our space has been designed with working guests in mind, with universal PowerPoints and plenty of comfortable seating.

From lunch through to dinner, discover the culinary delights of our fresh asian fusion menu. The carefully curated menu boasts signature dishes such as Ceviche with scorched chilli dressing, Chilli Octopus with green mango nuance cham, Lionfish Special Fried Rice with octopus and tiger prawns, and Sri Lankan Beef curry.
For our vegetarian and vegan guests, enjoy Rice Paper Rolls with sweet sour eggplant, and Tofu Char Kwetiau hot off the wok.
Pared with Kura Kura craft beer on tap, speciality cocktails and great vibes, you’ll be planning your next visit before the nights through.
Whether you're seeking a delightful brunch with friends, a cozy dinner date, or a peaceful place to work, Tigerlilly's Cafe welcomes you with open arms. With its enchanting ambiance &amp

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_tabs style=""boxed""][vc_tab title=""Description"" tab_id=""1421055594-1-76e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b019a153-74a0""][vc_column_text css=""""]Relax in your own private oasis nestled atop Jungutbatu hill, accessible by car or scooter right to the front door (no step-climbing required!). With its breath taking views of the ocean and Mount Agung, Casa Batu is the perfect accommodation for families or groups of friends, accommodating up to 9 guests. The villa consists of two bedrooms in the main house, a third and fourth bedroom in a separate pod with an external entrance. This layout provides guests with both their own private spaces and a generously sized common area for swimming, dining, or enjoying sunset drinks.

Casa Batu is a uniquely designed property divided into two sections, the main house and the lower-level pods. The main house includes an airy living room with a dining area, kitchen and sofa. On the upper floor, you'll find a king-sized bedroom, a twin bedroom, and a shared bathroom and toilet. Each room comes with its own private balcony, offering guests the opportunity to soak in the stunning views of the ocean, Mount Agung, and three surf breaks: Playgrounds, Lacerations, and Shipwrecks.

Nestled between the main house and the lower pods is the private pool, surrounded by a garden and sun loungers. A separate entrance leads to the third and fourth bedroom in the second pod, which feature a queen-sized bed with an en-suite bathroom and a private balcony.
The villa is located in one of Nusa Lembongan’s favourite locations, providing easy access to nearby restaurants and Coconut Beach.

We would like to inform you that there is construction taking place on a neighbouring property. We are in regular communication with the contractors and are doing everything we can to minimise any potential noise or disruption during your stay.
Please contact us if you have any questions.

column2: ><em>We had an amazing stay at Casa Batu! Widya &amp
column3: his team could not have been more helpful, attentive &amp
column4: friendly. Impeccable service! Breakfast was included in our booking, which the boys did an awesome job of - the most delicious pancakes! column1: Thank you Casa Batu for an amazing getaway with the girls!! We had a fantastic stay which was made so easy by Widya and his staff. Having our daily breakfast cooked for us was an added bonus which we looked forward to every day.
Thank you for your hospitality... we will definitely be back!

column2: >Amazing, would definitely return with an adult family group or girly trip again.

>Breakfast beautifully prepared by Made and his team. Location was reasonably close to town, but a taxi will be required. These are easily attained by Made whenever you require. There is a day club with great food that is walkable. Two of the bedrooms are in the main house and two are outside and down some extra stairs. Great for adult families with grown couple kids, maybe not so great with small children families. We were a group of women so it suited us perfectly. Made was available at all times, and was super friendly and abiding to all of our requests. Super full mini bar fridge, well stocked and priced for your stay, an added bonus.

column1: Some of the best service we have ever received in Bali. The space was roomy for our large family.
Brekky was great! Delicious and plenty of choice.

column2: >The place was great. The villa is beautiful and the view of the volcano is breathtaking. We had a wonderful stay thanks to the villa manager who organised our outings and was very responsive to all our requests, as well as all the staff of the villa who made an exceptional breakfast every morning. We can only recommend this villa.

column1: The staff, particularly Widya, were so welcoming and accommodating to all our needs. We felt at home, relaxed and really enjoyed our time at the Villa. The complimentary bottled water and other drinks to purchase in the fridge was an extremely convenient and very well priced. The traffic at night is a little noisy in the main house, but ear plugs are provided and it didn’t affect our sleep. The traffic noise is not a problem in the lower pods. We would definitely stay again. Thank you!

column2: >Our host, Widya was amazing and helped us out with everything we needed for our stay. Super nice and responsive. This really made it. Cheers Widya!

column1: Very nice landlord, very helpful tips, available at any time. Very good breakfast in the villa.

column2: >Very nice villa on the heights of Nusa, very clean, with an incredible view of the beach and the city centre. The team is very attentive, very welcoming and breakfast is included in the price of the night and that's a real plus! Widya is really available, he booked the scooters for our arrival and ordered a taxi for the return. Thank you again for your kind hospitality!
>Widya and the team are wonderful hosts and make you feel at home.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_tabs style=""boxed""][vc_tab title=""Description"" tab_id=""1421055594-1-76e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b0190865-b208""][vc_column_text css=""""]Villa Madu is a charming newly opened villa located in the Bukit area of Jungutbatu featuring one bedroom, one bathroom, open plan living and dining area, and a swimming pool.

Designed for couples seeking quality time away from Bali’s hustle and bustle, Villa Madu makes a perfect honeymoon villa. The villa boasts an all-white décor with high-quality furnishings made from locally sourced materials whilst the bedroom balcony features a net to sit back, relax and enjoy the sunset.
Enjoy the majestic view of Mount Agung and watch the surf breaks right from your bedroom. As night falls, Villa Madu transforms into a cozy and calm hideaway.
Villa Madu is located 5 minutes scooter ride away from Coconut Beach and the lively Jungutbatu's eat street.

Villa Madu is nestled in a lively neighborhood where a neighboring construction project is set to take place over the next few months. We are coordinating with the contractor to minimize any potential noise during your stay. However, due to the unpredictable nature of construction, we cannot guarantee the level of noise in advance. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

The balcony is adorned with a net, providing a comfortable spot to sit and enjoy the breathtaking views of Mount Agung and the ocean

column2: >Everything was amazing ! The corner shop is a fine food shop ! Location is ideal, on the hill, required a scooter or taxi all worth it !

column1: Thanks to the whole team for the super care over our 3-day stay there. Only recommendable. TOP!

column2: >Such a beautiful villa. Very peaceful and quiet. If you walk 5mins up the road there’s a grocery shop for snacks. Right across the road from the villa is a nice cafe with a beautiful view of the ocean. You can also use the pool too which was a bonus just to get out of the villa for a couple of hours. There wasn’t any construction noise or anything during our stay which was lovely.

column1: Great accommodation, we were able to relax well here. We were able to contact the manager of the accommodation at any time and he responded super quickly and helped directly! :-)

column2: >This was the best ending to my honeymoon. the service, the view, the amenities, just everything was great! I would highly recommend not only this space but also the host!

column1: Super nice accommodation!! Would go there again and again!🫶🏽

Incredible stay in a beautiful villa on a beautiful island🌴💙. Sublime beaches, perfect water and magical atmosphere from morning to sunset. A huge thank you to Ade, our butler, and Putu, the manager🙏❤️: super professional, available, and extremely kind. I asked Ade a lot and he always responded with a smile, attentive throughout. The motorbike is almost essential🛵: rented directly via Ade, low price and delivery in 5 minutes ⏱️ — perfect for getting around easily without wasting time (even without being a biker, it's simple). Right in front of the villa (3 m!), a great restaurant 🍹🍽️ open from morning until 9 p.m.: breakfast facing the sea, lunch with your feet in the sand, and a splendid sunset🌅. The team is adorable and it's ultra convenient on ""lazy"" days when you don't want to go far. In short, an unforgettable stay: impeccable service, superb setting, relaxed and romantic vibe✨💛. I recommend it 100% and I will come back without.

column2: >Putu was our villa manager and he was very accommodating and helpful! The villa was also beautiful!

column1: Villa was amazing!! Putu was the villa manager and he was incredible, he helped us with everything like scooter hire and taxis and would respond very quickly! I highly recommend!!

column2: >Host Putu was very responsive and responded to our requests immediately. Designed for couples seeking quality time away from Bali’s hustle and bustle, Villa Madu makes a perfect honeymoon villa. The villa boasts an all-white décor with high-quality furnishings made from locally sourced materials whilst the bedroom balcony features a net to sit back, relax and enjoy the sunset.
Enjoy the majestic view of Mount Agung and watch the surf breaks right from your bedroom. As night falls, Villa Madu transforms into a cozy and calm hideaway.
Villa Madu is located 5 minutes scooter ride away from Coconut Beach and the lively Jungutbatu's eat street.

Villa Madu is nestled in a lively neighborhood where a neighboring construction project is set to take place over the next few months. In consideration of potential disruptions, our current rates are uniquely discounted for guests staying until the anticipated completion in June 2024.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_tabs style=""boxed""][vc_tab title=""Description"" tab_id=""1421055594-1-76e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b019fef1-67d6""][vc_column_text]Villa Damai is designed with couples in mind, offering an  adults-only retreat in a secluded tropical environment. Experience the ultimate in tropical living, allowing the sea breeze to lull you into vacation mode the moment you step in through the front door.
Nature lovers would enjoy Villa Damai as the semi-open layout of the villa ensures fresh air circulation and opens directly onto the charming tropical garden.
True to its name, 'Damai,' meaning peace in Indonesian, the villa is situated in the quieter part of Nusa Lembongan, providing unbeatable views of the ocean, seaweed farms, and Nusa Ceningan.
The villa comprises a master bedroom, a bathroom with an outdoor bathtub and indoor shower, a comfortable living area with a dining table, kitchen amenities and a lounge area.
Enjoy the outdoors in the lush garden setting whilst taking a refreshing plunge into the 14-meter-long infinity pool, or unwind on a sun lounger while watching the day unfold.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tab][vc_tab title=""Rooms"" tab_id=""1421055594-2-62e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b019fef1-67d6""][vc_row_inner row_type=""row"" type=""full_width"" use_row_as_full_screen_section_slide=""no"" text_align=""left"" css_animation=""""][vc_column_inner width=""1/2""][vc_column_text]The main bedroom connects directly to the living area, featuring an L-shaped sofa, a dining area, and an open-plan kitchen. Adjacent to the bedroom, you'll find the bathroom, equipped with an outdoor bathtub, an indoor shower, two sinks, and a toilet with a bio septic tank system.

column2: >Thank you for a wonderful stay and beautiful staff.

column1: We have never stayed in a place like Villa Damai before. The outside and pool area is amazing, we spent so much time out there. The open concept is actually so cool and the communication throughout our stay was fantastic!

column2: >My wife and I stayed at Villa Damai for 5 nights and it was a wonderful experience. Our cleaner Wayan was extremely helpful, she cleaned the place perfectly everyday, helped us to clean our clothes and took us to fetch things from the mart. The outdoor area is perfect for a swim! We went to a few day clubs on the island and the pool at Villa Damai is definitely one of the cleanest and biggest on the island. The house is almost completely open with only curtains as doors/windows. The bed becomes enclosed with mosquito nets and an air conditioner which keeps the area cool all night.

column1: Villa Damai is an unusual place yet its by far the best Airbnb I’ve booked. It’s a great place to unplug. Wayan is very helpful and respectful. Be prepared to be surrounded by nature and get use to see geckos (big ones) !

column2: >incredible villa - atypical - neat - environment heavenly - peaceful - welcoming organized - services and procedures offered (pick up - massages at home - meals) - owner availability to respond to questions.

column1: We had a great stay at the villa. Everything looks at least as great as in the pictures! The decor is upscale and really very nice! There's nothing missing. The pool is huge and the view of the sea is simply indescribable. We enjoyed it.

column2: >Thank you in advance for the stay. However, I would like to make a few points that should have been communicated in the listing. The price is very decent, so you can expect everything to fit 100%. You have to note that the bathroom has no doors, which I think is important. You should also be able to make friends with small animals in the accommodation, as otherwise the villa is relatively open. The lady of the house is very courteous and friendly. The hostess also accommodated us, for which I would like to thank her again. All in all, a solid stay. The location and view from the villa are really very nice. You can reach everything quickly with the scooter. Thank you for hosting.

column1: We absolutely loved our stay at Villa Damai. We didn’t want to leave! Our first time in Nusa Lembongan and we are already talking about when we are coming back. The host and staff were absolutely amazing, super helpful and friendly.

column2: >I can't report anything negative We had a great stay at the villa. Everything was clean and as described. Communication was great at all times. An absolute recommendation!

column1: We absolutely loved our stay! Secluded and beautiful. Would highly recommend x

column2: >Beautiful villa! Nothing to say. The view from the villa is incredible, right by the sea! The infinity pool is perfect. It is an open villa so expect to see some animals (the bed is surrounded by curtains + mosquito nets). The host is very responsive, offers you breakfast which you can have at the villa! You can also get a massage at the villa! Just a sublime stay! I recommend this villa for relaxing for a few days.

column1: Unforgettable stay for our 10th wedding anniversary ❤️ unique place, facing the sea... The staff was very helpful and kind and answered all our questions.

column2: >Words fall short to describe this location. It is a combination of pure tranquility, the sound of the sea around you combined with a beautiful accommodation. Wayan is a mega nice and sweet host. I will definitely come here again.

column1: We had the most unforgettable stay at this beautiful oceanfront villa at Nusa Lembongan. The private infinity pool overlooking the ocean was absolutely breathtaking, and the outdoor bath added a special touch of luxury. A huge thank you to Wayan, our incredible contact at the villa — she was warm, responsive, and went above and beyond to help organise flowers and set everything up for a surprise proposal. It made our engagement extra special and something we’ll always remember. The villa was clean, peaceful, and perfectly positioned for oceanfront views and total relaxation. We couldn’t have asked for a more perfect stay. Highly recommend!

column2: >Perfect! Such a charming villa with fantastic views from the pool area. Sun hangs around until late in the afternoon making it a great all day spot. Wayan was fantastic to communicate with, very responsive and helpful. Didn’t have any issues with mozzies bug used the spray each night and the net around the bed. Felt very private and secluded, though it’s definitely off the beaten track and away from the main beach. recommend getting a scooter if you’re wanting to explore the island. Even then some of the roads in the area are quite sketchy. It is close to Ceningan bridge as well as dream and mushroom beach areas.

column1: We thoroughly enjoyed our time at the Villa, it is exactly as depicted in the photos. Peaceful, quiet, beautiful views, pool and lovely garden . Decor and open plan living superb and the outdoors are spacious leading you to the pool and the ocean waves that lull you to sleep at night and gently wake you in the morning! Totally private!

column2: >This was THE most beautiful place we have ever stayed. The photos are beautiful, but honestly do not do this villa justice. The view is priceless, the private infinity pool is huge, the bed was beautiful and comfy. It is open plan, but doors and curtains can be closed if preferred. We were worried about the heat due to the open plan, however, the bed is surrounded by curtains that somehow make bedtime beautiful and cool. Wayan and the other locals within the area were lovely, the night before we left, we advised the hot water had run out - which wasn’t an issue for us, we just wanted to let Wayan know so it could be remedied prior to the next guest. Not even 3 minutes later someone was there to replace the gas bottle. We will absolutely be visiting this villa again in the future.

column1: 20/10. Booked through the Lembongan Traveler and could not believe our eyes when we walked in. This place is movie type stuff, stunning is an understatement. The whole process from start to finish was easy and the hosts communicated well, made local recommendations and helped us every way through. Nusa Lembongan's #1 nanny and babysitting service, Nusa Baby Care, boasts a remarkable legacy of over 10 years and more than 10,000 bookings, establishing itself as a trusted companion for families seeking professional childcare services during their island getaway. The key to their success lies in a team of experienced and qualified babysitters, ensuring parents can relax and relish their holiday with peace of mind.

Nusa Baby Care stands out with its comprehensive offerings, catering to a range of parental needs. For families on a Lembongan holiday, the option of baby equipment hire ensures that every necessity for the little ones is met, contributing to a hassle-free and enjoyable vacation.

Safety is a top priority, and Nusa Baby Care goes the extra mile by providing pool fences for villas and Safety Gate Babyloos, ensuring a secure environment for children to explore. The babysitters are not only proficient in English but are also trained in first aid and CPR, guaranteeing a swift and effective response in case of emergencies. Their swimming capabilities extend to both pools and oceans, offering an additional layer of safety for water-related activities.
Recognizing the importance of nutrition, the babysitters are adept at preparing nutritious meals, catering to the diverse needs of infants, teenagers, and those with special requirements.

As a locally owned and operated establishment, Nusa Baby Care is deeply committed to delivering the best possible babysitting service on the island. Their dedication ensures that parents can immerse themselves in the beauty of Nusa Lembongan, creating lasting memories while their children are under the watchful care of experienced professionals.

Since its establishment in 2016, The Sampan Lembongan has remained dedicated to delivering a consistent and unique culinary experience centered around seafood and grilled specialties. Our unwavering commitment to taste and quality as our primary service focus has been the cornerstone of our success.

At The Sampan, we take pride in our signature dishes that have become synonymous with our name. Each dish is meticulously prepared to ensure that the flavors are always on point, keeping true to our distinctive culinary identity. Our vision is simple yet profound: to deliver an exceptional dining experience that revolves around the essence of taste and quality.

In addition to our exquisite seafood and grilled offerings, we offer a selection of 100% Arabica coffee, sourced from the finest beans. Our coffee is expertly brewed to perfection, providing a rich and aromatic experience that complements our dishes perfectly. It's not just a beverage
column2: it's a testament to our commitment to excellence in every aspect of our menu.

column1: Furthermore, our dedication to freshness extends to our daily bakery offerings. Each day, our skilled bakers craft a variety of pastries and bread, ensuring that our guests indulge in the freshest and most flavorful baked goods. From fluffy croissants to crusty bread, every item is made with care and attention to detail.
At The Sampan Lembongan, we believe that dining is more than just eating
column2: it's about creating memories. Whether you're enjoying our seafood specialties, sipping on our premium coffee, or savoring our freshly baked goods, we invite you to embark on a culinary journey with us.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_tabs style=""boxed""][vc_tab title=""Description"" tab_id=""1421055594-1-76e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b0198a23-4cf4""][vc_column_text css=""""]Gecko Villa and Bungalows offers boutique accommodation, featuring 5 traditional timber bungalows with alang-alang roofs, in addition to one main villa, all located on Mangrove Beach, Jungutbatu.

Gecko Villa and Bungalows enjoys the quieter side of the island while still being close to Jungutbatu's eat street, surf breaks, and swimmer-friendly beaches. Enjoy morning walks along the beach, or have your ice-cold beer in one of the nearby warungs come sundown.

Each bungalow features a king bed (convertible to twins), a TV, a wardrobe, a bathroom with a standing shower, a mini fridge, a water dispenser, and a private balcony with views of the pool and garden.

The main villa features a private pool, a spacious living room with a kitchenette, a master bedroom with a king bed, and a bathroom with a bath tub and standing shower. Enjoy the day goes by and panoramic views of the beach and Mount Agung from the villa from the observation deck.

column2: Bungalow complex is located close to a beachfront bar that hosts New and Full Moon parties. These celebrations happen on different dates each month, so please check with our team for the latest lunar party schedule.

column1: Relax after a long day of exploring the island in this traditional bungalow. Each bungalow features a king bed (convertible to twins), a TV, a wardrobe, a bathroom with a standing shower, a mini fridge, and a water dispenser, along with a private balcony that offers views of the pool and garden.
Featuring a private pool and sun deck, the main villa makes an ideal base for couples. The enclosed living room is equipped with a large sofa, a kitchenette, a TV, and a refrigerator.

column1: We really enjoyed our stay at the Gecko Bungalows. The bungalows are nicely furnished, with a comfortable bed and all amenities. The common pool was also really nice and we got to be the only users during the days that we stayed there.

column2: >Very nice accommodation, well located close to restaurants and beach bars, the pool is deep and very nice. Thank you very much to Joni for her help on many topics!

column1: I really enjoyed my stay at one of their bungalows. The bungalows are spacious and well maintained. The pool was always very clean. The staff is friendly and helpful. Joni who leads them is very kind and polite and helped me with finding the best transport options around the island. I will definetely stay again at Gecko next time I come to the paradise island of Lembongan!
Beautiful beach and snorkelling within walking distance. Delicious local food available at Nyoman's Warung, which is just a five minutes-walk away.
I felt very safe and the bungalows include a safety box and are locked with two doors (fly screen and actual door).
Key bars, restaurants, spas and attractions are within walking distance. They also rent scooters which you can use to explore the island as a whole and the neighbouring Ceningan Island.
They don't offer a full breakfast but they will provide UHT milk, tea and coffee for a simple breakfast drink. There are plenty of options of where to eat within 5-15 minutes walk.

column2: >Our stay at gecko was so lovely. Great location- close to nearly everything but far from buzz. column1: Let me start by saying I know the owner. But the only difference that makes to the review is that I bothered to post one, because I never review anything.

Their place is awesome. We stayed in the Villa, which is the bigger accommodation with its own space and pool. The pool is large as personal pools go and about a perfect a temperature as you could get. There is viewing everywhere out to the beach across the road and day beds to lounge around on.
The wooden construction and thatched roofing make you instantly feel on holiday.
We used every part - even the bath (which might be the best shaped bath I have been in for 2 people) - after finishing an extended snorkelling trip a bit on the cold side.
Joni (in particular) and all the staff are as helpful as can be. Nothing is too much trouble (even a second doona for my partner who sleeps like she is in the Antartic).

Lembongan is far and away the most relaxing area of Bali I have visited (and I have seen most of it in 6 trips) and this area is the perfect balance of being away from what amounts for hustle, but yet is less than 5 minutes scooter to the action and even the far side of the island is only about 15 minutes. Yes, scooter organised by Joni.
Did I mention the vista to Mt Agung which greats you each morning ? It might be a holiday, but it still worth getting up to the viewing platform each morning for sunrise.

We debated the perfect duration for staying again (even though we packed in snorkelling and jet-skiing already in our 3 night stay) and decided we could easily spend 5 nights here no problems at all just relaxing and drinking in the sunsets at a different location every night.
Looking for few relaxing days with a loved one ? Just book it!

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_tabs style=""boxed""][vc_tab title=""Description"" tab_id=""1421055594-1-76e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b019795a-e37d""][vc_column_text css=""""]Tropica Tranquility is a hidden gem nestled on Mangrove Beach in Jungutbatu. This new boutique resort features four charming bungalows, a one-bedroom apartment, a swimming pool, and an air-conditioned yoga shala, all set within a lush tropical garden and adorned with chic bohemian interiors.

Each bungalow includes a king bed, a minibar, a wardrobe, an en-suite bathroom with a shower, and a private balcony. The one-bedroom apartment offers a king bed, a kitchenette, an en-suite bathroom with a shower, a living area, and a spacious balcony.

As the only resort in the area with an air-conditioned yoga studio, Tropica Tranquility is perfect for intimate retreats or special gatherings with friends. Spend your days lounging by the pool or take a short walk to Jungutbatu’s beach for a truly rejuvenating holiday.

Disclaimer: Tropica Tranquility complex is just across the way from a beachfront bar that hosts New and Full Moon parties. These celebrations happen on different dates each month, so please check with our team for the latest lunar party schedule. A pair of earplugs are provided in each bungalow for your convenience.

We also want to inform you that the island is undergoing various developments, including in our area. Next to Tropica Tranquility, there is ongoing construction expected to continue until the end of 2025, with work taking place from approximately 9 AM to 6 PM. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding

column2: >Stay in this chic bungalow with a king bed, wardrobe, desk, and bathroom with a standing shower. Each bungalow comes with a private balcony overlooking the garden and pool. Size: 36 sqm.

>Located on the top floor above the yoga studio, the apartment is 90 sq m in size and features a king bed, sofa bed, a kitchenette, living room and walk in wardrobe. The outdoor balcony overlooks the ocean and comes with a sofa and high chairs to take in the view.
>This two bedroom villa features 140 sq m of space with a king bedroom and a twin bedroom, ensuite bathrooms with a bath tub in the twin room, a spacious kitchen and living area, and a plunge pool.
