column2: >Beautiful pool area. Great location - around the corner from the beach. Close enough to all shops and restaurants.

column1: A great, quiet place with very friendly and helpful staff, special thanks to Erni.

column2: >It was in the perfect spot to go and do some shopping, get breakfast, lunch and dinner, 5 minute walk to the beach front to relax, staff were amazing at the villa and will definitely recommend to family and friends.

column1: Tropica Tranquility is a hidden gem, with lovely huts tucked just off the main road. The accommodation has a high-quality finish with thoughtful details throughout, all designed with a strong sustainability approach. Debbie and the entire team were incredibly warm and welcoming, making the stay feel personal and relaxed. A perfect spot for a peaceful and eco-friendly getaway.

column2: >The Resort is a very nice, and calm place. The Service of the team is very good, aways very friendly and helpful, we had a great stay. They organise what ever you need. Motorcycle, laundry, and many things more.
column3: ><em>You feel welcome like in a family. Thank you, especially to Erni.

column2: >The bungalows offer space enough for two people including big luggage. The are lovely decorated and have a cute terrace.
column3: ><em>The Ocean is across the street, just 50m away you can enter through a nice fancy restaurant. Which has nice decorative tables in the sand on the beach. The neighbour has a Mini Golf ranch. They offer breakfast and other food. Junge Mangrove trips are close: 5-10 min by motorcycle.

column2: >I feel very save at this place, everywhere friendly and trustful people.
column3: ><em>Close to centre 15 min walk to many restaurants, bars and shops

column1: We really enjoyed our time at Tropica Tranquility. The pool was a lovely spot to be in the humid weather. Rooms clean and spacious, air conditioning worked well, filtered water with refillable drink bottles. It was at the Northern point of the island, which was sometimes a bit far to walk, but I found this the best part of the beach and our scuba diving was nearby. There was some work happening next door which was a bit noisy, but there is lots of work happening on the island.

column2: >Beautiful accommodation to the north of Lembongan, close enough to the main road but far enough back to enjoy some peace. Exceptionally clean rooms, well maintained grounds and super friendly staff. Will stay here again when we return to Lembongan.

column1: Beautiful boutique bungalows, super quaint, private and stunning decor. They have thought of everything to make the rooms most comfortable, lots of lovely little touches like natural mozzie spray, aftersun and full kitchen to use. From before we even arrived Ade was brilliant, organising our collection from the beach and a motorbike rental. Staff were incredibly friendly and helpful throughout our stay, nothing was too much trouble. Really thoughtful and beautiful birthday decor was laid out on the bed when we returned from diving one day. Debbie the kind owner also stopped to say chat when she was passing through which was lovely.

Location is excellent if you want somewhere off the main thoroughfare but still super close by all amenities. The Bar across the road does have a party twice a month for full and new moon, we went along and had a great time but if you didn’t want to the noise isn’t actually too loud to sleep, and earplugs were provided.
Did have a slight issue with the pool staining some of our swimwear but we made Ade aware and he came through with solutions quickly.

column2: >Really enjoyed our stay reasonably priced location good walking distance to everything shorter if you walked beachfront.
>Rooms: Bed comfy Cute clean rooms staff and owner's very nice
>Nearby activities: Utopia turtles and mantra ray tour excellent Hire of scooters through Tropica Tranquility awesome service Annie will organise for you
>Walkability: Careful when walking to accommodation at night the track isn't even and there isn't any lighting

column1: A truely wonderful, tranquil place. The bungalows and the space are amazing, so worth the extra spend. The pool is clean and a great size. It feels like it’s your own private space as there are only four bungalows. They are designed to contemporary perfection and have really nice interiors as well as super comfy beds. The staff are great and Debbie’s yoga is the best teacher I’ve been too. Furthermore- it’s super easy to walk to the beach and along the main strip. Loads of amazing places to eat, local and western and a great spa (Avo) a 2 minute walk away. Surfing with we surf is a must and renting scooters to explore is also a great experience. 10/10 would come again in a heartbeat. Such a beautiful place. We felt incredible lucky to be there!

column2: >This place was absolutely incredible and truly beautiful. The rooms were spotless and well maintained. With only four accommodations surrounding a central pool, it feels intimate and family-oriented—you instantly feel at ease. The staff were exceptionally attentive and made us feel so welcome. A hidden gem that offers comfort, charm, and genuine hospitality!
>Peaceful paradise with warm hospitality and perfect location.

>A true slice of paradise! The bungalows are stunning, the atmosphere is peaceful, and the staff are absolutely wonderful. Everything feels warm and welcoming from the moment you arrive. Perfect location—quiet yet close to great restaurants and beautiful beaches. Total heart-stealer!

column1: The place looks beautiful, and the pool is nice and refreshing.

column2: >Our stay was very enjoyable and the staff here are helpful. Rooms were quite small but did the job for only a few nights.
>Very calm and quiet location, we felt relaxed here as there are only 4 huts on the complex. Clean. Helpful and attentive staff who work here! Yoga studio next door.

><em>Lovely peaceful place for a large group to spend quality time together. The staff were very helpful but some of the ammenities were a little below par. For example the fridge in the main villa was unbalanced, unclean &amp
column3: faulty. But apart from these small inconveniences I would recommend Tropica Tranquility.

column2: >Tropica Tranquility is at the end of the main tourist area on Nusa Lembongan but that made for a more relaxed stay. You can walk to most things in 20 mins but a scooter (organised by the staff with a drop off and pick up of the scooter at the villas) made everything easier. The staff were great, always friendly and helpful. There was construction noise everyday between 8am and 5pm. TT can’t help that but it would have been good to know ahead of time.

column1: Very clean and modern Friendly and attentive hosts Great information manuals for local things, restaurants and excursions

column2: >I had the most incredible stay at Tropica Tranquility! From the moment I arrived, the staff were welcoming and helpful. I had the pleasure of meeting one of the owners, Debbie, who was so kind and thoughtful. She shared the story behind the property—that when they envisioned their boutique hotel, it was important to renovate an existing space rather than build new, in order to preserve the island’s natural green areas. I really admire their commitment to sustainable tourism—including offering complimentary filtered water and reusable bottles to help reduce plastic waste.

>I stayed in the one-bedroom apartment above the yoga studio, and it truly felt like my own private oasis. The bed was honestly one of the most comfortable I’ve ever slept in! I loved having a balcony and outdoor seating area—perfect for reading, relaxing, or just soaking in the peaceful atmosphere. The pool area was inviting and the perfect temperature, and the location couldn’t have been better—just minutes from the beach, local shops, and great restaurants. Already dreaming about my next visit!

Tanah Folk Fashion + Lifestyle Boutique is now open with a shopfront on Nusa Lembongan Island (in addition to our Canggu Store). Find us located on the corner, next to our friends ‘The
Little Coconut” café, on the main street of Jungutbatu Beach.

After many years of travelling to this tropical paradise, we are thrilled to open our Island Folk Store. Tanah Folk’s aesthetic features mindfully crafted clothing with elevated styles in fabrics that make them perfect for travel.

We cater to many styles, with pieces that transition perfectly from day-to-night, or beach-to-bar, with an elevated, yet laid back look to all our garments. In addition to our handmade garments, we also stock wearable accessories with jewellery, sandals and headwear, as well as some beach essentials from other brands such as zincs and suncreams that are reef safe and personal favourites of ours.
You can browse most of our products online at www.tanahfolk.com to get a taste of what you could find in-store, although we’d love for you to visit as trying on our garments will help you
choose the perfect fit and we know you’ll fall in love with the fabrics, prints and the way our products drape.
We look forward to seeing you in-store xx

This stylish villa offers two bedrooms split in two levels with en-suite bathrooms, providing plenty of space for families or groups of friends.
The downstairs bedroom features a queen bed and a single bed and a semi-outdoor bathroom. The upstairs bedroom is a cozy room with a king bed, a bathroom, and a netted balcony for lounging.

Designed with an open-plan living and dining area, Villa Madu Dua is perfect for both socializing and relaxing. The décor maintains an elegant all-white theme with high-quality furnishings made from locally sourced materials.

Take in the stunning views of Mount Agung from the bedroom balcony, or enjoy watching the surf breaks right from your room. As evening sets in, Villa Madu Dua transforms into a serene and cozy hideaway.
Conveniently located just a 5-minute scooter ride from Coconut Beach and the vibrant Jungutbatu eat street, Villa Madu Dua offers easy access to local attractions while providing a tranquil retreat.

Villa Madu Dua is nestled in a lively neighborhood where a neighboring construction project is set to take place over the next few months. We are coordinating with the contractor to minimize any potential noise during your stay. However, due to the unpredictable nature of construction, we cannot guarantee the level of noise in advance. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

column2: >We thoroughly enjoyed every minute of staying in Madu Dua. The villa was everything we expected and more. We woke to stunning views of Mt Agung each morning. column1: A heavenly stay in Nusa Lembongan! I spent a far too short stay of 2 nights in early August, with my spouse and our 2 children. We loved it, but what a pity we were there for so little time. As for the accommodation, a peaceful haven, in all simplicity, comfortable and very clean... On site we moved around by scooter. Thank you again for your hospitality!

column2: >The villa is splendid with an amazing view. The service is impeccable and we were very well received. Even though work was announced, we didn't hear any noise and fully enjoyed our stay in peace. A place I would recommend in a second.

column1: We spent 3 nights in the house, superb, magnificent view, well located, friendly host and impeccable services.

column2: >We had an amazing stay at Villa Madu Dua 2. The view was absolutely stunning, especially during sunset—truly a highlight of our trip. Despite some nearby construction, it didn’t disturb us at all and the peaceful atmosphere of the villa remained intact. The villa itself is beautiful, with a lovely pool and well-maintained grounds. The location was great—close enough to everything we needed, yet tucked away enough to feel relaxing. Getting around was easy and convenient. The staff were fantastic—quick to respond and always helpful, which made our stay even more enjoyable. If we were to offer one kind suggestion, it would be to consider relocating the water fountain to a more suitable spot and improving the hot water system, as it currently runs out after one short shower—not ideal for a group of five. Overall, we had a truly wonderful stay. Thank you to the entire team for your hospitality!

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_tabs style=""boxed""][vc_tab title=""Description"" tab_id=""1421055594-1-76e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b019134b-bbe8""][vc_column_text css=""""]Nestled on Jungutbatu Hill, a newly developed neighbourhood celebrated for its breathtaking views of Mount Agung, the ocean, and lush jungle, Villa Utopia offers a serene escape with 1 and 2-bedroom villas. Conveniently located just 5 minutes drive from Coconut Beach and the vibrant Jungutbatu eat street, the villas boast 180-degree views of their stunning surroundings.

Designed to be airy and inviting, Utopia Villas seamlessly bring the outdoors in while embracing sustainable living. The villas use solar panels, maintain chemical-free pools, and prioritise locally sourced furniture and amenities. Whenever possible, food-grade cleaning products are also used for an eco-conscious stay.

• One-Bedroom Villa (50 sq m): Perfect for couples or solo travellers, this villa includes a twin bed (convertible to king), a plunge pool, an en-suite bathroom with a standing shower, a living room, a kitchen, a covered seating area, and a sundeck.

• Two-Bedroom Villa (100 sq m) : Ideal for small families or friends, this villa features a king bedroom and a twin bedroom (convertible to a super king), a private 6-metre pool, en-suite bathrooms with standing showers, a kitchen and dining area, a semi-outdoor living area, a covered seating area, and a sundeck with two sun chairs.

The villas can be booked individually or as a complex, making them a versatile 3 bedroom complex for any occasion. A connecting door by the poolside allows easy access between the two villas whilst still maintaining the privacy of guests.
Please note that the villas are located in a rapidly growing neighbourhood with ongoing construction nearby. To ensure your stay offers great value, we’ve adjusted the pricing accordingly.
Family with young child is advised to rent a pool fence due to infinity pool design. Our team can assist with recommending a vendor for pool fence.

column2: >We felt completely comfortable! Dika provided excellent service – he picked us up directly from the beach from the ferry and took us to the Airbnb by taxi. The ambience and the furnishings are fantastically beautiful, the apartment is in a quiet location and invites you to relax. The construction work next door, which was already mentioned in the description, was absolutely relaxed and not at all disturbing. The excursion organised by Dika was particularly great: we went out on a private boat with two guides, saw mantas, dolphins and much more – an unforgettable experience! In addition, he also organized a scooter for us directly at the accommodation, which was super practical. We also met the owner of the villa, which made the stay even more personal and beautiful. Overall, we felt perfectly in good hands. One of the nicest Airbnbs I've ever been to – absolute recommendation!

column1: We felt like in a 5* hotel. From the welcome to the End, everything was perfect. Super service and always very helpful. Many thanks to Dika. We had the opportunity to use the large villa for only two people and it was great. Also we were super helped with the arrival and departure. Thank you for everything!!!

column2: >Our stay was really awesome! We enjoyed it so much. Dika is the best! The accommodation is beautiful and even better than in the photos 🫶 we will come back!

column1: We spent 6 wonderful days in this accommodation and really had the best time here. The location is quiet and private, with a fantastic view of Mount Agung. With the scooter you can be in the middle of the action in a few minutes and easily reach many great restaurants and small shops. We also found the drinking water dispenser particularly practical – it makes the stay much more pleasant. A special thank you goes to Dika, who was always there for us with his friendly and open manner when we had questions, organised the scooter and even got us softer pillows 🥹 The owners Helen and Tom were also incredibly warm and helpful. Currently, there is a construction site next to the villa, but it hardly disturbed us – the construction noise was only heard for a limited time (usually in the morning). We highly recommend this accommodation and would come back anytime! 💛

column2: >Villa Utopia exceeded our expectations in every way. The view is unforgettable — the village of Jungut Batu spreads out below, the surf breaks sparkle on impossibly blue water, and across the channel, Gunung Agung rises from Bali wrapped in clouds. Mornings were bliss with coffee in hand and birdsong drifting up the hill. The villa is impeccable, airy, and modern, with light streaming through floor-to-ceiling linen-draped windows that open onto the lush patio garden, pool, and sweeping coastal panorama beyond. Every detail is intentional, in perfect order, and luxurious. Especially appreciated is the super-comfortable bedding and cloud-soft pillows — a place for deep rest. It feels remote but still close to town — yet just steps from a lovely café, and deli for stocking up. Didn’t need to leave for two days! The photos don’t do it justice — the whole place has a serene, special energy. It’s a place so memorable it stays with you.

column1: 5-star everything! Service, communication, amenities, comfort. The only place we’ve ever stayed in Lembongan where we weren’t woken up by roosters at 4am. Amazing views. Organic chlorine-free swimming pool. The service here was better than the villa in Bali we stayed at prior for our wedding, where we spent a significant amount more per night. Special thanks to Dika for his efforts in meeting us at the dock and assisting with our bags, it made all the difference after a big day travelling. Thank you team for an amazing stay.

column2: >Beautiful villa! Everything was clean, the check in and out process was seamless, and the staff was incredible!

column1: This villa is pure paradise! Spacious, peaceful, and with the most stunning view over the turquoise waters of Lembongan, Bali, and Mount Agung in the distance. Everything is perfectly set up, you can even enjoy the view from the bathroom! It’s private and quiet, surrounded by nature, with birds and butterflies in the morning. The pool is lovely and fresh, the kitchen fully equipped with great coffee and a cold water dispenser, and the internet strong and reliable. The solar system means lights and A/C always work, even during power cuts. The shower is powerful, the bed super comfortable, and the décor charming. It truly feels like a dream home. The owners are wonderful, kind, and helpful in every way. I didn’t want to leave and could easily get used to waking up to that view every day!

column2: >This was the most beautiful Airbnb accommodation on our round trip. Newly opened (12/24), an unbelievable view, a mad island with moderate tourism, great hosts (thank you @Tom) and above all a huge thank you to Dika! Even a concierge of a 5-star hotel would be jealous of the effort and this self-evidence. We would give more than 5 stars!

column1: We had an absolutely fantastic stay at this villa! The view was simply breathtaking and exceeded all expectations. A grocery shop was conveniently located just around the corner, making everything super easy. Beautiful beaches were only about 8–10 minutes away, and the restaurants and town were just a quick 5–7-minute scooter ride. The service throughout our stay was top-notch — attentive, friendly, and always ready to help. We can only highly recommend this place!!

column2: >Incredible experience, a spectacular view and a wonderful welcome from Dika, I will definitely come back.

column1: ✨ A Paradise on Earth – An Unforgettable Stay! ✨

<em>From the moment we arrived at Villa Utopia, we knew right away: this is pure perfection. Our stay was truly magical. We felt like millionaires in this stunning home, set in a breathtaking location with spectacular views over nature and the ocean. The cleanliness of the villa is impeccable
column2: every detail is perfectly taken care of. The swimming pool is an absolute dream: crystal-clear water surrounded by a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. The service and hospitality deserve the highest praise. Dika was always available, extremely helpful, and made sure everything went perfectly. The owners clearly have a big heart for their guests
column3: their warm guidance and attention made our stay even more special. In short, Villa Utopia truly lives up to its name. A place where luxury, comfort, and tranquility come together beautifully. We enjoyed every moment and can’t wait to come back. A must-stay for anyone looking for the best Nusa Lembongan has to offer! 🌿🏝️

column2: >Had a great stay!! Has everything you need to stay a few days on the island. Everything was super clean, responded quickly!! Would recommend the villa to everyone. Supermarket is at walking distance. A really great stay!

column1: We have enjoyed this beautiful villa for 3 days! Fully equipped and the view is fantastic! Dika, the villa manager, helped us with everything and was super friendly. Highly recommended!!

column2: >Stunning property with incredible views. The bed was so comfortable with soft, high quality linen. The restaurant/beach strip in a few minutes. We loved our stay and would recommend.

column1: The accommodation is exceptional both in terms of decoration and location. Special mention to the villa manager 😊

column2: >We loved our stay at Villa Utopia. The house was beautifully furnished with beautiful view. Our host Andika was amazing, he helped us with all our queries which made our stay really comfortable. The place was a bit far from the main areas, so we needed to rely on private taxi to get us around the island. Which was ok, because we just enjoy the house. Thank you again for a very memorable stay.

column1: Our stay at Villa Utopia was great! The villa host from The Lembongan Traveller was so helpful and good to deal with! Would 100% recommend this villa to anyone!

column2: >​The Villa was nice and clean. The service was excellent. I highly recommend it.

column1: Absolutely fantastic villa, could not fault it!
The moment we walked through the gates we knew it was going to be amazing stay. Kids thought that we must be millionaires to be able to afford this place 😀.
Kitchen is well equipped with everything you may need for your stay. Bedrooms have very comfy and large beds, pillows were amazing too.

Bathroom showers were by far the best we’ve had in Bali. Water is hot and water pressure is top notch. Pool is good size and the view from the pool and backyard is one of the best you can have on this island, looking right over Mount Agung.

Dika was so super accommodating with absolutely everything. From booking us scooters to getting us some ice cold Bintang Crystals in the fridge for the check in time. Owners Helen and Tom are so welcoming, and the whole team will make sure that your stay is nothing but perfect.
Although not located on the beach, it’s only short ride away and the location is actually so nice and quiet with very limited traffic.
PS! If you’re looking for a nice relaxing place for dinner and cocktails, go to Karana pool club! Only couple minutes from the villa and the best food we had on the island.

column2: >The most beautiful accommodation of our stay in Bali, it was simply amazing!

column1: Beautiful villa, more beautiful than we could imagine. Worth every penny!

column2: >We had a wonderful stay at the villa. The owner and staff are very nice and the accommodation is beautiful. Thank you!

column1: Feels like home, clean, bright, beautiful scenery, holiday resort. The butler is very nice, I will come back if I have the chance.

column2: >We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this beautiful villa on Nusa Lembongan! The hosts were incredibly friendly and welcoming, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. The villa was spotless and perfectly maintained, offering everything we needed for a comfortable and relaxing holiday. The view was simply breathtaking – the perfect backdrop for enjoying a morning coffee or watching the sunset. The location couldn’t have been better, close to great restaurants, beaches, and attractions, yet peaceful and quiet. We can’t recommend this place highly enough and would love to come back!

column1: Beautiful place. Thank you very much to Dika, great welcome.

column2: >Very nice villa, neat decoration, very comfortable bedding, the pool and air conditioning a real plus. A very nice view from where you can enjoy the sunset Dika, the manager of the villa, is really very nice and attentive to help you enjoy your stay. The villa is quiet and close to the centre (not even 5 minutes by scooter). I would highly recommend 😉

column1: The accommodation is stunningly beautiful! The view from the pool is fantastic, as you can see the sea. The accommodation is beautifully furnished, has everything you need, and even two duvets of varying thickness. The host is very friendly and wants you to feel comfortable. Highly recommended if you want to spend a quiet time on Nusa Lembongan.

column2: >Highly recommended. The staff and owners are very nice. The villa itself is beautiful. Great view!

column3: you can get anywhere on the island in 10 minutes.

column1: Highly recommended! The staff was very friendly and organized a lot for us. The stay was wonderful. The decor is beautiful. The best accommodation during our stay!

column2: >Awesome place with a great view. Tom and Helen are awesome hosts which help to organize everything you ask. They know the people on the island and share the nice places to go to, restaurants, diving schools, snorkeling, surfing. The place itself is very stylish and has all what you expect. Overall 6 star rating, which is not available unfortunately. Highly recommendable!

column1: This was mine and my partners favourite place we’ve ever stayed! Our room was private with the most beautiful views and our own private pool. Villa manager Dika went above and beyond for us as it was a special occasion so we were super grateful! Can’t recommend this villa enough we will definitely be back.

column2: >Absolutely beautiful villa! We enjoyed our stay very much and definitely recommend the place. Overall everything is very clean, the bed is comfortable, the bathroom modern and the living area simply enjoyable with the private pool! Dika, the house manager, is very kind and helpful - the communication was very easy via whatsapp. The Villa lies on the hill in the middle of the island, so you can decide everyday what side you want to explore, I liked this. 5-10 minutes by bike to both sides.

column1: This is such a beautiful spot. We absolutely loved our stay at Villa Utopia. The Villa is beautifully appointed and the view incredible. Thank you, we can’t wait to come back.

column2: >I had such a great stay here! The view was absolutely amazing, and everything was so clean and well looked after. The bed was super comfy, which made it easy to relax, and the location was perfect so close to everything I needed. A big thank you to Dika as well, he was so helpful throughout my stay, organising everything for me and always responding quickly whenever I had a question. He even helped arrange snorkeling and other activities, which made my trip even better. I’ll definitely be visiting again. highly recommend staying here!

column1: We had a fantastic stay at Villa Utopia in Nusa Lembongan. From the moment we arrived, we were met at the ferry by friendly staff with a taxi ready, such a warm and welcoming start. At the villa, we were given a full tour and treated to refreshing welcome drinks, which was a lovely touch. The staff went above and beyond throughout our stay, helping us book local transport, a snorkeling trip, and a mangrove tour. We highly recommend Made Travel for exploring the island! When our 1-year-old had an accident, the team responded immediately—organising a taxi to the local medical center and staying with us the entire time. Special thanks to Dika for his incredible care and to Tom, the owner, for checking in on us personally. Villa Utopia is not only stunning, but the service is exceptional. We’ll absolutely be back and will recommend it to anyone visiting Nusa Lembongan. Thank you, Dika and Tom, for making our stay so memorable!

column2: >The stay was wonderful, the villa is beautiful and the view over the infinity pool to the sea is priceless. A place to relax and unwind. Dika from the Lembongan Travellers was like Donna (if you know the series Suits😉). He anticipated our every wish and was always immediately on the spot. The villa is at the top of the mountain, but you can get down quickly by taxi or scooter. If you book your stay here, you can look forward to relaxing days in Lembongan. We will definitely be back. We ourselves are a family with 3 children. We also met the landlords, a loving family who also gave us many tips. He is from Germany and she is from Finland, with little Emil 🥰 Thanks for everything – 🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼

column1: I had a great stay! The accommodation was very clean, well-equipped, and exactly as described. I would especially like to highlight the pool: Due to my skin allergy, I'm usually very cautious, but here I had no problems at all – no itching, no irritation. The water was pleasant and very well-tolerated for sensitive skin. This made my stay even more relaxing.

column2: >What an incredible villa! We loved everything about our stay-the villa is spotless, beds super comfortable, great pool and spotlessly clean. Dika was a phenomenal host, so helpful all the time! It was also lovely to meet the owners Tom and Helen who were equally as friendly and helpful! We will definitely be back.

column1: The place is fantastically beautiful! The view from the pool is great, because you can see the sea. The accommodation is beautifully furnished, you have everything you need and even 2 different thick duvets. The host is very friendly and wants you to feel comfortable. Absolute recommendation if you want to spend quiet days on Nusa Lembongan.

column2: >Stunning place, the decoration is lovely and the pool with views amazing. The bed was the only one comfy bed i found during my trip in Bali. Dika was all the time taking attention to everything. It is really a 10/10 place. And the smell is amazing.
>A beautiful villa. Fabulous customer service. We will definitely be back and recommend to all!

column1: The host was so helpful, and the villa was very private and in a beautiful setting. The pool area is absolutely heavenly. Great location close to everything by scooter.

column2: >We highly recommend Utopia Villa Lembongan for families. The owner is warm and welcoming, and the staff are incredibly helpful. Thank you Bli Dika, making all our arrangements. ❤❤❤

Located on the main road to the mangrove forest in Nusa Lembongan, Nyoman's Warung has been delighting guests since 1999 with its delicious food, stunning ocean views, and the majestic backdrop of Mount Agung. Originally named Fresh Coconut, the warung was renamed in its second year to honour its owner, Nyoman, and has been a beloved local gem ever since.

As the first eatery on the mangrove road, Nyoman's Warung has delighted guests with its signature dishes, Grilled Jacket Fish and Fish in Banana Leaf, both prepared with authentic Balinese flavours. These classics remain a must-try, alongside a variety of seafood, chicken, and vegetarian options.

Perfect for group gatherings, Nyoman's Warung offers buffet packages for a minimum of 4 people and up to 100, with menus tailored to your preferences and budget. Whether it’s a family meal or a special celebration, the warung ensures a memorable experience.

To make dining even more convenient, Nyoman's Warung provides free pick-up and drop-off services, as well as delivery to accommodations across Nusa Lembongan. Planning a wedding or birthday party? The warung also caters with its signature Balinese dishes like grilled fish, prawns, and customised buffet menus.
With seating for up to 50 guests indoors and 60 guests on the beachfront, Nyoman's Warung is the ideal spot for both intimate meals and lively group gatherings.
Come and savour the true taste of Bali at Nyoman's Warung!

Just a step away from Tamarind Beach, Tales Bookcafé offers a cozy spot to enjoy good coffee and great reads. The café features a library with 900+ secondhand books from a wide mix of genres, including both fiction and non-fiction as well as some reading for the little ones. Guests are welcome to read while enjoying their coffee, or make use of their book swap system— bring a used book and trade it for a new story to take home. With no bookshop on the island, Tales’ library is a unique offering, making it a must visit for book lovers. There is also an assortment of board games that you can use freely in the café.

Aside from coffee, they also offer a variety of different teas and an assortment of cold-press juices. The menu includes both hot and cold options, from paninis and vibrant salads to hearty bowls and an all-day breakfast menu. If you’re in the mood for something heavier there is also a dinner menu, featuring delicious burgers, and authentic Swedish meatballs.

Whether you’re looking for a quiet place to enjoy a meal or a refreshing drink after exploring the island, Tales Bookcafé is the perfect place to unwind. Stop by and experience a small oasis for all book lovers alike!

Designed in a modern, minimalist style, this villa is perfect for families or groups looking for a relaxing getaway. With large open spaces, a private pool, en-suite bathrooms and stunning ocean views, it offers the perfect balance of comfort, luxury and relaxation with magical sunset views.

The cliff villa features a completely open-plan design with no partitions between the living, dining, and garden areas, creating a seamless connection to the outdoors. This setup makes it easy to gather with loved ones, enjoy the ocean breeze, or soak up the tropical atmosphere. An entertainment lounge is equipped with 98” Smart TV, plus 55"" Smart TV in each bedroom, perfect for movie nights while the expansive garden and pool are perfect for cooling off while taking in the beautiful views.

Villa Ocean Blue can sleep up to 8 guests across four bedrooms. With its open design, Ocean Blue creates a sense of freedom and connection to the natural beauty of Sandy Bay. Whether you're swimming in the pool, relaxing in the open living spaces, or enjoying the view from the garden, this villa offers a truly unique and refreshing experience.

• Master Bedroom: This open-space bedroom overlooks the pool, garden, and ocean. At night, it can be enclosed with floor-to-ceiling glass doors. It includes a king bed and an en-suite semi-outdoor bathroom with a luxurious bathtub.

column2: 3rd Bedrooms: Both bedrooms have king beds that can be split into twin beds, making them great for families or friends. Each room also has a desk, a semi-outdoor bathroom, and a 55” smart TV.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_tabs style=""boxed""][vc_tab title=""Description"" tab_id=""1421055594-1-76e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b019134b-bbe8""][vc_column_text css=""""]As the only villa with access to a private beach cave on the island, Seaview Private Villas offers a unique experience for families, couples or groups, seeking a memorable and affordable stay.

Nestled in the between Coconut Beach and Tamarind Bay area, Seaview Private Villas offers a mix of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom villas, located on different levels. For larger groups or special occasions, you can book the entire complex as a spacious 6-bedroom villa for the ultimate privacy.
1-Bedroom Villa: Features a cozy queen bed and a private en-suite bathroom. Located on the highest level of the property.

2-Bedroom Villa: Includes one room with a queen bed and another with twin beds, both with their own en-suite bathrooms and sharing one air-condition from the living room. Located on the mid level of the property.

3-Bedroom Villa: Offers a master bedroom with a queen bed and private en-suite, plus two bedrooms (twin and queen) that share a bathroom. This villa is sharing one air-condition in the living room, while there is a ceiling fan in each of the bedrooms. Located on the lower level of the property, ideal for those with mobility issue or travelling with young children.

Each villa is designed to make your stay as comfortable as possible, with spacious living areas, air-condition, ceiling fan, Wi-Fi, TVs, and fully equipped kitchens for your convenience. Whether you’re spending time indoors or exploring the surroundings, you’ll find everything you need to feel at home.
Guests can also enjoy the property’s shared facilities, including a refreshing swimming pool and an on-site restaurant serving delicious meals just steps from your villa.

One of the highlights of Seaview Private Villas is its exclusive private beach cave, located at the base of the property. This hidden treasure is only accessible via the villa’s lift and offers a secluded spot to relax and soak in the natural beauty of Tamarind Beach, exclusive to villa guests only.

Whether you’re looking for a peaceful retreat or a fun seaside adventure, Seaview Private Villas is the perfect choice. With its prime location, breathtaking views, and exceptional amenities, it’s the ideal setting to create lasting memories with your loved ones.

Step aboard Utopia Catamaran, your ultimate luxury escape from the pristine shores of Nusa Lembongan. More than just a boat trip, Utopia offers a 4-in-1 experience that blends adventure, indulgence, and relaxation into one unforgettable day.
Relax on spacious decks featuring floating beanbags, cozy sun loungers, and up to 30 comfortable chilling spots. Soak up the sun, sip a drink, and let the sea breeze rejuvenate you.
Try paddleboarding, floating beanbags, second level jumps, and more. To capture every moment.

Explore the island’s best snorkeling spots with premium gear provided. Swim among vibrant coral gardens and marine life, guided by our expert crew. We also provide GoPro videos and photos of your adventure.

Enjoy a gourmet buffet prepared fresh onboard, from breakfast with a view to a curated lunch or dinner depending on your cruise. Fruits, snacks, and sweets are also served along the way. A welcome drink and water are included throughout your cruise. There is also full service bar onboard with cocktails and other beverages for purchase.
With only 20 guests per shared cruise (or up to 30 for private charters), every journey is designed for comfort, style, and unforgettable memories.

Nestled along a pristine stretch of coastline in Nusa Lembongan, 3 Monkeys Beach Club offers an idyllic escape combining beachfront relaxation, wellness, and entertainment. Located in the bustling Jungutbatu area, it's accessible via a 30-minute ferry from Sanur, making it an appealing escape from Bali's busier mainland and features twelve thoughtfully designed apartment-style rooms for those who are looking for a stay on Nusa Lembongan.

The club’s commitment to wellness is evident throughout the property. Guests can maintain their fitness routines at Island Fit, their beachfront open air gym, equipped with modern exercise equipment that caters to all levels of fitness enthusiasts. After a workout, indulge in the rejuvenating sauna or take a refreshing plunge in the ice bath, designed to invigorate your body and enhance recovery. Both of which feature ocean views!

At 3 Monkeys Beach Club, healthy living is a priority, and the on-site restaurant reflects this ethos. Serving a delectable menu of nutritious meals throughout the day, the culinary team emphasizes fresh, locally sourced ingredients to create vibrant dishes that satisfy both the palate and the body. From energizing breakfasts to wholesome lunches and light dinners, guests can enjoy a variety of options that cater to different dietary preferences.

The beach club’s inviting atmosphere comes to life at night as the perfect destination for sunset drinks and is ideal for groups, couples, families or solo travellers. With access to stunning beaches, wellness amenities, and a focus on healthy cuisine, 3 Monkeys Beach Club is not just a place to stay
column2: it’s a lifestyle destination that nurtures the mind, body, and spirit. Whether you’re seeking adventure or a peaceful retreat, this hidden gem promises an unforgettable experience.

Here, you’ll find a thoughtfully curated destination that blends natural beauty, conscious living, and the timeless spirit of artisanal craftsmanship. Whether you're seeking something beautiful for your home, a meaningful gift, or a moment of peace, NALU invites you to slow down, breathe deeply, and connect with the magic of the island.

Reimagine your living space with our handpicked collection of island-inspired home decor, each item telling its own story of craftsmanship, culture, and care. Our pieces are lovingly handmade by skilled local artisans who use ethically sourced and sustainable materials such as natural fibers, reclaimed wood, and hand-poured brass. From intricately woven wall hangings and elegant rattan pieces to carved wooden decor and unique brass cutlery, every item is designed to infuse your home with warmth, character, and a deep sense of island serenity.

Express your inner free spirit with our signature collection of travel-ready fashion and soulful accessories. Our boutique features lightweight, flowy dresses, one-of-a-kind jewelry, hand-beaded rings and bracelets, and artisanal accessories including woven hats and beach bags — each item thoughtfully crafted for comfort, beauty, and versatility. Whether you’re wandering barefoot on the beach or heading out for a sunset dinner, our pieces are designed to move with you, celebrate you, and capture the carefree essence of island living.

Feel the stress melt away with our in-store traditional Balinese massages. Our experienced local therapists deliver every session with heart and healing hands, creating a space of pure relaxation and renewal.

Explore the island your way! We offer motorbike rentals for easy island adventures, and we’re always happy to share local tips, secret spots, and activity recommendations to help you make the most of your stay.

Your Go-To Fitness Space on the Island.

Established in 2018, K Gym Lembongan is proud to be the first and most established gym on Nusa Lembongan. Surviving the pandemic and growing stronger each year, K Gym continues to be the go-to training space for both locals and island visitors looking to stay fit while enjoying paradise.

Conveniently located in the heart of the island, K Gym offers a fully air-conditioned, enclosed training space with a spacious layout and more than 20 high-quality fitness machines and equipment. What truly sets Karuna Island Spa apart is its signature Water Healing Spa Therapy — a 120-minute full-body ritual that blends modern spa techniques with the power of water and nature. This unique treatment includes:

[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

column2: > Top Variety of Draught and Craft Beer
>Looking for a casual spot to enjoy a cold draught beer or cocktail with friends, enjoy authentic Italian pizza, and hang out late into the night? You’ve found it.

>At Baliwood Social Club, we’ve got everything you need for a laid-back, fun-filled time. With beachside seating, a spacious beach dining area, and stunning views of Mount Agung across the ocean, our fully air-conditioned sports bar is the perfect place to catch live games on big screens, play pool or darts, and relax with great company.
>We serve authentic wood-fired pizza, homemade fresh pasta, and classic pub grub.
>Our head chef has years of experience cooking up world class dishes at some of the best Italian restaurants in Bali. We guarantee our pizza will give you a ""true Italian"" experience.
>Baliwood Social Club has the largest selection of draught and craft beers on the island! Heineken, Guinness, Bintang, San Miguel, IOI Craft, Coopers Green, Asahi — just to name a few.
>Enjoy your drink with your feet in the sand and volcano views in the distance — perfect for sunset or a chilled afternoon by the beach.
>Pair that with our extensive cocktail, seltzer, and wine offerings, and we’ve got your perfect drink covered.
>We take bookings, offer delivery, and cater for special parties.

""description"": ""Baliwood Social Club is a casual beachfront sports bar and Italian restaurant on Nusa Lembongan, Bali. Serving authentic wood-fired pizza, homemade fresh pasta, classic pub grub, the largest selection of draught and craft beers on the island, cocktails, seltzers and wine. Features include live sports on big screens, pool, darts, beachside seating with views of Mount Agung, full air conditioning, takeaway delivery and event bookings."",
""text"": ""Baliwood Social Club is located on the beachfront in Jungutbatu, Nusa Lembongan, Bali, Indonesia. The venue offers beachside seating and views of Mount Agung across the ocean.""
""name"": ""What type of food does Baliwood Social Club serve?"",

""text"": ""Baliwood Social Club serves authentic Italian wood-fired pizza, homemade fresh pasta, classic pub grub, and a full breakfast menu. The head chef has years of experience at some of the best Italian restaurants in Bali.""
""name"": ""Is Baliwood Social Club a sports bar?"",

""text"": ""Yes. Baliwood Social Club is the leading sports bar on Nusa Lembongan, with live sports on big screens, pool tables, darts, and a fully air-conditioned indoor area in addition to its beachside dining.""
""name"": ""What drinks are available at Baliwood Social Club?"",

""text"": ""Baliwood Social Club has the largest selection of draught and craft beers on Nusa Lembongan, including Heineken, Guinness, Bintang, San Miguel, IOI Craft, Coopers Green, and Asahi. The bar also offers cocktails, seltzers, and an extensive wine list.""
""name"": ""Does Baliwood Social Club take bookings or offer delivery?"",
""text"": ""Yes. Baliwood Social Club accepts table bookings, offers food delivery, and caters for private events and special parties. Bookings can be made via WhatsApp at +62 853 3658 7904.""
""name"": ""Is Baliwood Social Club good for families?"",

""text"": ""Yes. Baliwood Social Club is family-friendly during the day and early evening, with beachside dining, wood-fired pizza, and a relaxed atmosphere. The sports bar area is also popular with groups and couples.""
""name"": ""How do I get to Baliwood Social Club from mainland Bali?"",

""text"": ""Take a fast boat from Sanur to Nusa Lembongan (around 30 to 40 minutes). Baliwood Social Club is located in Jungutbatu, the main village on Nusa Lembongan, easily reached by scooter or short taxi ride from the harbour.""

Comfortable Amenities: Each tent features air-conditioning, a private bathroom with a bidet, tea and coffee maker, mini-bar, and sea views. Additional amenities include a work desk, outdoor furniture, and free toiletries.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_tabs style=""boxed""][vc_tab title=""Description"" tab_id=""1421055594-1-76e001-77c57db5-d8b72d60-13bc1b68-b019134b-bbe8""][vc_column_text css=""""]Welcome to Villa Nomadas – Nusa Lembongan’s Newest Luxury Beachfront Retreat

Step into a world where barefoot luxury meets the timeless charm of island life. Perched on the pristine shores of Nusa Lembongan, Villa Nomadas invites you to slow down, breathe deeply, and savour the simple elegance of Indonesia’s most enchanting island.

Here, the spirit of gotong royong – the Indonesian tradition of community and togetherness – is woven into every detail. From your sunrise welcome by our local staff to the warm smiles shared over daily offerings of incense and flowers, Villa Nomadas is more than just a villa – it’s a celebration of Balinese culture, respect for nature, and meaningful connection.

Villa Nomadas offers two architecturally designed villas, each with its own private swimming pool. Whether you’re seeking solitude or coming together with friends and family, the villas can be enjoyed separately for privacy or opened up as a single, spacious compound for a shared island experience.

Expect wide open living spaces, locally crafted timber finishes, breezy bedrooms that spill onto the pool gardens, and all the thoughtful details that make a stay feel effortless and refined. Lounge poolside, take a stroll down to the beach, or simply let the rhythm of the tides guide your day.
From sacred sea temples to coral reef adventures, Villa Nomadas is your personal gateway to the slow, soulful pace of life on Nusa Lembongan.
Welcome home to island life – redefined.

Disclaimer: Villa Nomadas complex is located near a beachfront bar that hosts New and Full Moon parties. These celebrations happen on different dates each month, so please check with our team for the latest lunar party schedule.

71328,"BAR RIVA","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]
Bar Riva – A Slice of the Mediterranean on Nusa Lembongan
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

Bar Riva is a Mediterranean-inspired beachfront bar and restaurant nestled on the sun-soaked shores of Nusa Lembongan. Designed to evoke the timeless charm of Italy’s Amalfi Coast, Bar Riva combines coastal elegance with warm Indonesian hospitality, offering a refined yet relaxed atmosphere from morning until late evening.

Open daily from 6:30 AM to 11 PM, Bar Riva invites guests to start their day with rich coffee and nourishing breakfast options as the ocean sparkles just steps away. As the day unfolds, the venue transforms into a vibrant social space where Mediterranean flavours shine. The menu features Italian-inspired dishes prepared with fresh, local ingredients—perfect for long, leisurely lunches or intimate dinners under the stars.

Signature handcrafted cocktails, curated wines, and chilled aperitifs flow effortlessly from the bar, complementing each meal and elevating every occasion. With an emphasis on quality and creativity, the drinks menu is as much a highlight as the cuisine itself.

What truly sets Bar Riva apart is its beachfront location. Whether you're lounging in the shade, celebrating a special event, or catching the golden hour with friends, the setting is as stunning as the food. Sea breezes, curated playlists, and stylish design details complete the experience, creating a perfect harmony between laid-back island life and coastal European sophistication.

Ideal for couples, families, and groups alike, Bar Riva is more than just a restaurant—it’s a destination where good food, great drinks, and unforgettable moments come together. Whether you're a local or a traveller seeking a taste of the Mediterranean in paradise, Bar Riva offers a unique, welcoming escape that captures the magic of coastal dining at its best.

Welcome to The General, Nusa Lembongan – the island’s coolest café and artisan bakery, serving locals and travellers from sunrise into balmy island evenings.

Open daily from 7am to 10pm, we’re your local caffeine dealers, pouring expertly crafted coffee from Blacklist Coffee Roasters, as well as matcha and smoothies to kickstart you day. Our modern brunch menu is legendary, with vibrant dishes that keep you coming back – from smoothie bowls to hearty plates that fuel your surf and scooter missions.

Our artisan bakery serves up freshly baked goods daily, perfect for a grab-and-go treat or a slow morning of people watching. From 5pm, The General transforms into your neighbourhood wine bar and pizzeria, dishing out signature sourdough pizzas and handmade pasta to pair with quality imported wines and cold beers.
Families love The General too. Keep the kids entertained with unlimited drawing paper, pencils, and playing cards, so you can savour your coffee (or wine) in peace.

Find us easily on the main street of Jungut Batu, just a few steps from the beach. Whether you’re here for your morning matcha, a sunset pizza session, or your daily caffeine hit, The General is your island home for good vibes, good food, and friendly smiles.
Come see why The General is Nusa Lembongan’s most talked about café and bakery.

column2: > Ceningan brings together a chill, tropical vibe and stylish Balinese design in a secluded coastal setting. Situated on the island’s western cliff with access to the white sands of Secret Point Beach and the famed surf break at Mahana Point, it’s a serene escape from Bali’s more bustling beach clubs

column1: From its elevated dining terrace down to the pool and sand‑filled sun terraces, the layout is thoughtfully tiered. Made from natural wood, stone and bamboo thatch, the décor is rustic yet refined, blending local craft with modern flair. Three sweeping levels descend toward the ocean, each lined with comfy daybeds, beanbags under palm trees, and a swim‑up bar by the pool. A bonfire pit adds cosy ambience at sunset.

The atmosphere is laid‑back and family‑friendly, welcoming children and even pets. There’s no entry fee—but premium seating requires a minimum spend. Staff deliver warm Balinese hospitality—efficient yet genuine.  The soundtrack is mellow—background beats and soft island tunes rather than pulsing club music—encouraging relaxation over revelry.

Cuisine here is fusion‑style and world-class—combining traditional Balinese ingredients with contemporary techniques—served in generous portions. Expect fresh salads, Indonesian classics, burgers, pizzas, grilled meats, and an inclusive range of dishes tailored to vegan, vegetarian, gluten‑free, and kids’ needs. The signature cocktails—named after Indonesian tribes and fruits (like Aga with watermelon &amp
column3: lychee)—are a highlight alongside imported wines, local beers, smoothies and juices.

column1: As the afternoon progresses into evening, the atmosphere shifts subtly: golden‑hour light reflects captivating sunsets off tranquil waters, and a gentle breeze softens the day’s warmth. While Suku doesn’t promise the party energy of mainland beach clubs, it shines as a peaceful, stylish hideaway for relaxing days spent lounging, sipping cocktails, and soaking up Nusa<span style=""font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif

In essence, Suku Beach Club is designed for those seeking effortless tropical elegance—a place to unwind in casual comfort, enjoy thoughtful food and drinks, and experience the soulful fusion of nature, culture, and island‑chic style.

72892,"EAST MEDICAL CARE CENTER","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]
East Medical Care Center - Trusted Healthcare in Nusa Lembongan
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

East Medical Care Center (EMCC) is the leading medical center on Nusa Lembongan, dedicated to providing high-quality care, treatment, and facilities for both locals and visitors. With Lembongan being one of Bali’s busiest tourism destinations, we understand the importance of having a reliable and professional medical facility close at hand.
Founded to give peace of mind in times of need, EMCC is equipped to handle a wide range of medical concerns, from minor treatments to emergencies. Our facilities include:

Conveniently located in the heart of Lembongan—near Mushroom Beach, Secret Beach, Sunset Beach, the Yellow Bridge, and Jungut Batu Beach—our clinic can be reached within 5 minutes by local transport. For urgent situations, our ambulance and escort team are on standby 24/7.
📞 In case of emergency, please call our 24-hour hotline: 0813 3955 5515

For more complex cases, EMCC’s medical evacuation team is ready to arrange safe and timely transfers to advanced hospitals in Bali. Depending on the situation, patients can be evacuated by speedboat or helicopter to the nearest appropriate facility in Denpasar.

Our multilingual staff are highly trained and chosen for their expertise, professionalism, and compassion. We are committed to patient-focused, evidence-based care, ensuring that every person—local or visitor—feels supported and well looked after during their time on the island.

72937,"VICTORY CARGO","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

Victory Cargo is a company engaged in freight transportation services from Sanur to Nusa Lembongan (Jungut Batu) and back to Sanur. Victory Cargo consistently provides the best service. The boat / ship  used by Victory Cargo measure 11.5 x 2.5 meters (length x width) with cargo storage space measuring 8 meters long, 2 meters wide, and 1.7 meters high. They are powered by two 250 hp engines, allowing for faster delivery, with an estimated travel time of 45 minutes to 1 hour. Victory Cargo’s boat can load goods weighing up to 4 tons.
Victory Cargo's address is Jalan Hangtuah (Sanur Beach or Bangsal Beach) and we drop off at Jungut Batu Beach (in front of the D'Star office).

We can transport various types of goods, including groceries (household goods), building materials, hotel supplies, electronics, vehicles such as motorcycles and bicycles, hotel and villa supplies, and ceremony supplies. The types of packaging that we usually accept are cardboard, plastic/bags, sacks, boxes, styrofoam, jerry cans, baskets.

Deliveries can be made at the Sanur counter. Our counter opens at 6 a.m. and closes at 12 p.m. If you have dry goods you'd like to have delivered the next day, please bring them directly to our counter during those hours. If you'd like to send larger items, such as furniture, please contact us in advance.

72939,"ALL YOGA TRAINING","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

All Yoga Training offers Yoga Alliance–certified 200-hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali. Our intimate 23-day course is practice-focused, so you build real teaching skills and deepen your personal practice with close guidance.

Our trainings welcome motivated beginners and experienced practitioners. You’ll study Ashtanga Vinyasa, Creative Vinyasa Flow, pranayama, meditation, subtle anatomy, and teaching methodology in a supportive setting.

The studio is a beachfront shala in Jungut Batu, Nusa Lembongan—steps from cafés, guesthouses, and the beach. Sea-breeze ventilation, an open roof line, and ocean views create a calm study environment.

All Yoga Training began in 2009 with a simple idea: make high-quality yoga education accessible, practical, and community-minded. Our international teachers mentor small groups so each student receives personal feedback and clear direction. The course is capped at 24 students for better learning, with individual mentoring from a world-class team with decades of combined experience. By graduation you’ll be ready to lead safe and inspiring classes for all levels.
Certification is Yoga Alliance 200-hour, recognized internationally so you can teach anywhere in the world.

Getting here is simple: from Bali airport, taxi to Sanur Harbor, then take a speedboat (~30–45 minutes) to Nusa Lembongan. Many students choose Arthamas Ferry since our shala is next to their arrival point.
Student life is easy on the island. Affordable cafés offer vegetarian, vegan, and raw options. Rest days arrive every sixth day—perfect for surfing, snorkeling with manta rays, or a Balinese massage.

The villa offers the perfect balance of quiet, comfort, and convenience—just a short stroll from the beach, surf breaks, local shops, a supermarket, and some of the island’s most popular cafes and beach clubs.

Designed for families and groups, Villa Cahaya features five bungalows, each with air-conditioning, en-suite bathrooms, and cozy interiors that invite rest after a day of island exploration. The villa sits within a lush tropical garden shaded by mature trees, where guests can relax in the spacious pool, swing in a hammock under the stars, or enjoy sweeping views of the ocean and Mount Agung from the deck. Dolphins, surfers, and golden sunsets often provide the backdrop to evenings here.

The villa’s modern kitchen is fully equipped with high-quality appliances—ideal for private dining or entertaining family and friend gatherings. Guests can cook themselves or request in-villa dining prepared by friendly local staff. There’s also a comfortable TV and games room, high-speed Starlink Wi-Fi, and multiple lounge areas for both socializing and quiet relaxation.

[be_search][/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text]Bali Hai Cruises - Lembongan Island Beach Club

Bali's premier cruise company has carried more than 2.5 million guests since commencing service in 1990. Bali Hai Cruises provide a door-to-door transfer from your Bali hotel** to Nusa Lembongan and back. That includes:
- Air-conditioned transfer from your Bali hotel** to Benoa Harbour
- Cruise aboard the Bali Hai II to Nusa Lembongan with morning tea
-  Enjoy a BBQ lunch on your day of arrival
Bali Hai Cruises will collect guests from their Bali hotel** using one of their fleet of air-conditioned vehicles and drive them to Bali Hai Cruise reception centre at Benoa Harbour.
Guests can leave their luggage with the staff at the Benoa reception centre for transportation to Nusa Lembongan.

Guests will be given priority boarding and seating on the luxurious catamaran Bali Hai II for the 14 nautical mile cruise to Lembongan (lasting around 60 minutes). Departure is at 9.15am. Morning tea is provided during the cruise.
On arrival in Mushroom Bay, Bali Hai staff will meet the guests and escort them to the Hai Tide Beach resort reception for check in or for further transfers in Lembongan.

Hai Tide Beach Resort guests can take advantage of the range of activities available at the Beach Club and on the 40 metre offshore Reef Pontoon equipped with a 35 metre water slide and underwater viewing chamber.
The return cruise on Bali Hai II arrives back in Benoa Harbour at 4.15pm. Guests are then transferred to their Bali hotel**.
** Bali transfers include all south Bali areas (including Ubud) but exclude Candidasa.

[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

Welcome to Aquam – meaning water in Latin, where tropical vibes meet island life. Nestled on the stunning Nusa Lembongan Beach, offering breathtaking views of the mountains of Bali and surrounded by turquoise waters and captivating beauty. Immerse yourself in ocean inspired wellness. With a commitment to sustainability and supporting the local community, we offer authentic experiences and unforgettable moments.

SEAWEED BATHS – Indonesia is the world’ s largest producer of tropical seaweed, this seaweed is hydrocolloid, rich in vitamins, minerals and antioxidants it produces a jelly like substance which instantly hydrates the skin. Seaweed grows quickly and has a low carbon footprint.

At Aquam we rinse and steam the seaweed before adding it to our baths. Enjoyed for its muscle soothing, anti-inflammatory and hydrating qualities and when we are done we recycle it back to the earth as it makes an excellent soil enhancer. The type of seaweed we use is called katoni. At Aquam we understand that Bali and its outer islands have a fresh water crisis, so we have Desy, our salt water desalinator – Desy extracts water directly from the ocean, purifies and desalinates the water making it a sustainable way to bathe.

If you are exploring Jungutbatu in Nusa Lembongan and looking for a unique island boutique to visit, we would love to welcome you to Kamaya Island. Our space reflects everything we love about island life. Slow mornings, ocean air, creativity, and meaningful pieces made with intention.

We are best known for our handmade sea glass jewelry. Each piece is crafted from genuine sea glass collected along Bali’s shores and naturally shaped by the ocean over time. No two pieces are the same, which means every necklace, bracelet, or ring carries its own story. For us, sea glass is about transformation. Something once discarded becomes something beautiful again. If you are searching for sea glass jewelry in Nusa Lembongan or a keepsake that truly feels connected to the island, this is what we hope you will find here.

Alongside our jewelry, we curate sustainable islandwear designed for tropical days and slow living. Our clothing is breathable, effortless, and easy to wear from beach mornings to sunset dinners. We also offer postcards and small keepsakes so you can bring home a simple reminder of your time in Lembongan.

column2: Organic Spa, a unique healing spa located on the beautiful island of Nusa Lembongan. Established in 2012, our spa is dedicated to offering something different from typical spas on the island, authentic therapeutic healing treatments designed to restore the body naturally.

column1: The spa was founded by experienced therapist I Wayan Rantau, who has spent many years developing specialized healing techniques that combine traditional bodywork, Ayurvedic therapies, and holistic energy healing.

While many spas focus mainly on relaxation or luxury experiences, Lembongan Surf Spa focuses on deep therapeutic treatments that help the body recover from pain, fatigue, stress, and energy imbalance. This makes it a perfect place for travelers, surfers, and anyone looking for genuine healing during their stay in Nusa Lembongan.
Our Special Traditional Healing is designed for guests experiencing conditions such as:
• Shoulder stiffness or limited arm movement
• Lower back pain radiating to the legs
Using targeted pressure points, nerve therapy, and deep muscle techniques, this treatment focuses on true healing rather than simple relaxation.
Our spa is known for several powerful healing therapies rarely found in other spas on the island:
A traditional therapy that helps improve circulation, detoxify the body, and release deep muscle tension. This treatment is especially effective for back pain, stiff muscles, and chronic fatigue.
A calming energy therapy that helps restore the body’s natural energy flow, reduce stress, and support emotional and physical well-being.
Using therapeutic sound vibrations, this treatment helps relax the nervous system, clear energy blockages, and bring the body into a deep state of healing.
A specialized massage that stimulates the lymphatic system to help eliminate toxins, reduce swelling, improve circulation, and boost immunity.

Inspired by the ancient Indian system of healing practiced for more than 5,000 years, Ayurvedic therapies such as Shirodhara and Dosha Massage help restore the body’s natural balance, calm the mind, and promote deep relaxation and well-being.

In addition to our therapeutic healing treatments, we also offer beauty and relaxation services including manicure, pedicure, creambath hair treatment, nail care, hair braid, and traditional facial treatments, allowing guests to enjoy a complete wellness and beauty experience during their stay.
• The only spa in Nusa Lembongan specializing in therapeutic healing treatments
• Signature therapies including Fire Cupping, Reiki Healing, Singing Bowl Therapy, Lymphatic Massage, and Ayurveda
• Founded and led by experienced therapist I Wayan Rantau
To better serve our guests, our spa is available in two convenient locations in Jungutbatu:
• Lembongan Surf Spa – located on the main road of Jungutbatu, easy to reach for travellers and surfers.
• Lembongan Organic Spa – located near the steps leading to Batu Karang, offering a quiet and relaxing atmosphere close to nature.

If you are looking for more than a regular massage, a place where your body can truly recover and recharge, we warmly welcome you to experience one of the most unique healing spa treatments on Nusa Lembongan.

Welcome to Tiga Cemara Cafe, right on Jungutbatu’s main street — a bright and easy-going spot where the island slows down and everything feels simple. Our clean white space with natural wood touches and a little Japanese garden outside sets the tone: calm, refreshing, and full of light. Inside, it’s cool and spacious, with air‑conditioning, friendly faces, and a relaxed island rhythm that makes you want to stay awhile — whether for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

From 7 a.m., the smell of fresh pastry fills the air. We bake everything daily — croissants, puff pastries, brownies and our famous cinnamon rolls, loved by nearly everyone who walks in. Our house-made banana bread, chocolate and mango cakes are crowd favourites that disappear fast. Our coffee is roasted from premium Indonesian beans, smooth and rich — it’s often called the best on the island. We also serve decaf, plant‑based milk, and a perfectly balanced ceremonial matcha latte.
Our breakfasts are always a hit — the Avocado Smash is simple, fresh and loved by everyone, and our Norwegian Croissant with smoked salmon and the Bacon &amp
column2: Egg Croissant are perfect if you need a quick, tasty bite before surfing or diving. We’ve also got early bird specials — fresh pastry and coffee at a special morning price — plus our Island Lunch Deal from 12 to 3 PM, with 15% off all main dishes.

column1: Our menu brings together fresh local ingredients and soulful flavours with a Western twist. We love good food that’s honest, generous, and full of flavour. Try our signature Bali Spices Chicken Curry, Sweet &amp
column2: Sour Chicken Fried Rice, or the colourful Mango Smoothie Bowl with fresh local mango. For vegetarians, our Pumpkin Falafel Rice Bowl and Garden Salad with local avocado are light, vibrant, and full of goodness. Every dish is prepared with care, using locally sourced produce and house‑made sauces.

column1: What makes Tiga Cemara truly special is our people. Guests often tell us how friendly and genuine our team is — everyone is greeted with a smile and treated like a good friend. It’s that warm island energy that turns a simple meal into a memorable experience.
“Tiga Cemara” means Three Firs — a symbol of calm, nature, and timeless comfort. That’s exactly how we want you to feel here: relaxed, grounded, and happy.
Come for breakfast, stay for lunch, return for dinner — and don’t leave without a cinnamon roll.

Sober Diving Centre, located in the heart of Nusa Lembongan’s prime dive area, is a PADI 5-Star Dive Center known for its high training standards, strong safety record, and premium diving experience.Diving in Nusa Lembongan, or its much greater sister Nusa Penida, can be amazing. The Nusas, as they are familiarly called there, are a unique experience. It is almost certain you will be able to dive with Mantas Alfredi (aka Reef Mantas). It is amazing to observe them all year round flying above cleaning stations or performing a mating train.

Offering everything from beginner Discover Scuba sessions to professional-level IDC training, the center also runs daily fun dives, freediving courses, and even unique activities like underwater hockey—making it suitable for divers at every level.

What truly sets Sober apart is its top-tier facilities and efficiency. The center features one of the island’s largest and best training pools—a 25-meter standard pool—allowing confined water training and skill development to happen smoothly in one place. Combined with a fleet of large, modern, and fast dive boats, trips are more comfortable, efficient, and time-effective.

With easy access to world-class dive sites around Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Penida—famous for manta rays and the elusive mola mola—Sober Diving Centre is the perfect starting point for unforgettable underwater adventures. Whether you're just getting started or advancing your diving journey, Sober delivers a professional, seamless, and elevated dive experience.

column3: >Set amongst beautiful, cooling gardens and a lush lawn, Jati Indah Villa offers a truly relaxing island atmosphere, complemented by a pool that sits just off the tranquil, shaded verandah—perfect for slow mornings or unwinding in the afternoon.

Unlike many villas built for large groups, this is a place where every space feels just right, whether you’re travelling as two couples, a family, or simply escaping with your favourite people.

Set on an expansive piece of land, the villa features a stunning 20-metre infinity pool overlooking the ocean — a rare luxury for a private villa designed for only four guests. The main villa embraces an open-air, seamless living concept, with no walls separating the master suite, kitchen, dining, and living areas. Everything flows naturally together, creating a relaxed indoor-outdoor experience that feels immersed in nature and the sea breeze.

What truly makes Villa Kingfisher special is the feeling of being looked after. Led by villa manager, Budi, the team delivers warm and personalised service throughout your stay, including memorable dining experiences such as the private Taste of Nusantara dinner — a beautiful way to explore local flavours from the comfort of your villa.

Designed for complete seclusion, it’s perfect for guests seeking extra privacy while still sharing the villa experience together.

Gep’s Deli was born from a simple idea: to make quality ingredients and reliable groceries available on the island. When finding good food was a challenge, we built a place that could serve both residents and hospitality businesses with consistency, care, and taste. Today, Gep’s Deli has become a trusted supplier and grocery hub for villas, cafés, and locals across Nusa Lembongan and Nusa Ceningan, bringing convenience, freshness, and a touch of comfort to island living.
Built on flavor, trust, and a love for good food.

Gep’s Deli supports the island’s growing hospitality community by providing consistent, high-quality supplies for kitchens that value good ingredients. We work closely with villas, cafes, and restaurants to deliver reliable products, from frozen meats and cheeses to dry goods, cleaning essentials, and imported specialty items. Our goal is simple: to make sourcing easier so every kitchen can focus on what matters most — creating good food and great experiences.
Need groceries, fresh produce, or quality ingredients without leaving your villa?
We deliver everything fresh, fast, easy, and just the way you need it.
We’re here to make grocery shopping and sourcing on the island simple, reliable, and convenient.
• Villa Grocery Delivery – Your fridge, stocked and ready, without leaving the pool.
• Pre-Arrival Stocking – Send your list before arrival, find it ready when you check in.
• Freshly Brewed Coffee – Quality coffee available daily.

column2: Snack Supply – Drinks, chips, and sweets for your minibar or beach day.

Based in Nusa Lembongan, Kalm Charters offers private experiences designed for travellers seeking a more personal way to explore Bali and the surrounding islands. From seamless island transfers and relaxed sunset cruises to full-day adventures and custom itineraries, every journey is tailored to the pace and interests of each guest.

Built around comfort, flexibility and genuine hospitality, Kalm Charters provides exclusive access to some of Indonesia's most beautiful destinations, including Nusa Penida, Ceningan, Lombok, the Gili Islands and Bali's east coast. Whether it's a snorkelling trip with friends, a romantic sunset on the water or a day spent discovering hidden beaches and bays, each experience is thoughtfully curated around what guests want to see and do.

Designed to comfortably accommodate up to 25 guests, the vessel features spacious indoor and outdoor areas, premium amenities, refreshments and a dedicated local crew who know the waters and islands intimately. The experience is relaxed and effortless, with a focus on quality service and creating memorable moments on the water.

As an extension of Kalm Lembongan, Kalm Charters reflects the same philosophy of slowing down, connecting with nature and embracing island life. Ideal for couples, families and groups, each charter offers the freedom to explore at your own pace and create a day that feels uniquely your own.
Whether you're arriving in style, celebrating a special occasion or planning a personalised day on the water, Kalm Charters invites you to experience the islands differently and find your kalm.
Charter prices and itineraries can be fully customised to suit your preferences and travel plans. Simply get in touch with the team to discuss your ideas and create a personalised experience.
