Nestled in the heart of Nusa Lembongan, Baruna Warung has been proudly preserving Indonesia's culinary heritage since 1997. For nearly three decades, we have welcomed travelers and locals alike with one simple mission: to celebrate the authentic flavors, traditions, and stories that have shaped Indonesian cuisine for generations.

Indonesia is home to one of the world's richest culinary landscapes. With more than 17,000 islands and hundreds of regional cultures, every province has its own unique recipes, spice blends, and cooking traditions. At Baruna Warung, we believe these recipes deserve to be preserved, shared, and celebrated. Our menu is a tribute to this remarkable diversity, bringing together beloved dishes that represent the heart of Indonesia's heritage.

Every plate is prepared with respect for tradition. We use fresh local ingredients, aromatic spices, and time-honored cooking techniques that have been passed down through generations. From our signature Babi Bumbu Bali and traditional Nasi Campur to slow-cooked rendang, handcrafted sambals, and authentic Balinese specialties, each dish tells a story of family, culture, and place.

As Indonesian cuisine continues to evolve, our commitment remains the same: to honor its origins while presenting it with the quality, consistency, and hospitality that today's travelers appreciate. Alongside our heritage dishes, we also embrace the relaxed island lifestyle of Nusa Lembongan with wholesome breakfasts, specialty coffee, fresh tropical juices, and handcrafted beverages, creating a space where tradition and modern café culture come together naturally.

More than a restaurant, Baruna Warung is a place to slow down, connect, and experience the true spirit of Indonesian hospitality. Whether you're discovering these flavors for the first time or returning to the dishes you grew up with, every meal is an invitation to experience the richness of Indonesia's culinary heritage.
We invite you to eat local, discover authentic flavors, and become part of a story that has been shared around our tables since 1997.

Set within Kalm Lembongan in Jungutbatu, the Kalm Cowork Lounge is a relaxed, air-conditioned space with high-speed Wi-Fi, comfortable work areas and plenty of room to settle in.

Whether you need to catch up on a few hours of work, get through some emails or simply find a quiet spot with a book, the lounge offers an easy place to spend some time away from the busier parts of the island.

Inside, there are dedicated work areas as well as comfortable sofa seating. If you prefer to sit outside, garden seating areas offer another place to open your laptop, read or take a break between calls.
Food, coffee and drinks can be ordered directly from Kalm Kitchen and delivered to your table, so there’s no need to pack up when it’s time for lunch or your next coffee.

78940,"DAWN by Lago","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]
DAWN by Lago - Nusa Lembongan's All Day Beachfront Café
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

The door at DAWN opens at 6AM. Sitting right on the beachfront, DAWN is an all-day café made for slow mornings, long breakfasts and easy afternoons by the sea. The west-facing space catches the morning light, with indoor seating for cooler moments and outdoor tables extending towards the sand. It is a relaxed place to start the day, whether you are stopping by before a morning surf, meeting friends for coffee or simply taking your time.

Breakfast is served from 6am to 2pm, with a menu that brings together familiar breakfast favourites and thoughtful local touches. Expect generous plates, lighter options and something for every kind of morning, from a proper breakfast after an early start to something simple alongside your first coffee. Fresh pastries, house-made pies and baked treats are available throughout the day, making DAWN just as easy to visit for a quick bite as it is for a long, unhurried meal.

Coffee is at the heart of DAWN. Beans are ethically sourced from plantations across Bali and Java, with a full selection of espresso-based coffees served hot or iced. Alternative milks and decaf are available, alongside freshly pressed juices, smoothies, young coconut and a considered selection of teas and other drinks.

As the day moves on, DAWN naturally shifts with it. The morning breakfast menu gives way to lighter grazing and afternoon drinks, with local beers, seltzers and a DAWN Aperol Spritz on tap. There is no need to make a separate plan for the afternoon. You can simply stay where you are and let the day change around you.

The setting is a big part of what makes DAWN feel at home on Nusa Lembongan. Outside, consciously constructed furniture creates a relaxed space for lingering, while beachside bar leaners and bench seating sit closer to the beach. Inside offers a cooler retreat from the midday sun. The west-facing position brings changing light throughout the day, keeping the space connected to the beach beyond.

DAWN fits naturally into island life. Start with coffee before heading out on the water, settle in for breakfast, return for something from the pastry counter, or stay into the afternoon as the light moves across the beach. There is no particular way to spend the time here.
Open daily from 6am to 6pm, DAWN is a place to start slowly, eat well and let the island set the pace.

78947,"DUSK by Lago","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]
DUSK by Lago - Dining by the Sea on Nusa Lembongan
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

DUSK brings a beachfront dining experience like no other on the island. The restaurant’s west-facing deck makes the changing sky part of the experience. Lunch moves easily into afternoon drinks, before the space settles into dinner as the sun begins to disappear.

The setting is contemporary, with an open connection between the dining room, the verandah and the beach beyond. Natural light moves through the space during the day, while the atmosphere becomes warmer and more intimate towards evening. Outside, the deck looks across the ocean, giving guests a front-row view as the afternoon turns into sunset.

Seafood is at the heart of the menu, with an emphasis on sustainably caught fish and fresh local ingredients. One of the signatures is Captain Kuniya’s Coconut Ceviche, made with fish brought in that morning by Kuniya, who runs his jukung (a traditional Indonesian small wooden outrigger boat) from Coconut Beach. The menu also brings together Australian, New Zealand, local and Southeast Asian influences, with a range of seafood, meat and vegetarian dishes.

The drinks follow the same approach, with cocktails drawing on Indonesian ingredients and flavours, alongside wines from Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, Chile and Europe. It is an easy progression from an afternoon drink on the deck to dinner as the evening settles in.

Every Thursday, DUSK invites guests to pull up a seat and enjoy an exclusive Chef’s Table. The five-course Chef’s Table menu changes from week to week based on the season’s best catch, the morning’s harvest and the chef’s inspiration. With limited seats available, it offers a more intimate way to experience DUSK.

Open daily from 11am to 9pm. Whether you are celebrating a special occasion, looking for that one memorable dinner on the island or simply want to dress up for the evening, DUSK offers an elevated dining experience like no other in Nusa Lembongan.

78954,"SUNDECK by Lago","[vc_row row_type=""row"" use_row_as_full_screen_section=""no"" type=""grid"" text_align=""left"" background_animation=""none"" padding_top=""32"" css_animation=""""][vc_column width=""1/2""][vc_column_text css=""""]
SUNDECK by Lago - Open-Air Wellness on Nusa Lembongan
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

Set above the coastline at Lago, SUNDECK offers a different approach to wellness on Nusa Lembongan. Rather than being separated from the rest of the experience, the open-air space sits naturally within Lago, allowing guests to move between wellness, conversation, the ocean and dining throughout the day.

The elevated setting looks out across the coastline and Mount Agung, with shaded areas, natural materials and an open-air layout that keeps the sea and island surroundings close. The atmosphere is calm without feeling overly quiet or formal, making SUNDECK as much a place to spend time as it is a place to focus on wellness.

At the centre of the experience are the cold plunge and panoramic sauna, positioned beside one another with views towards the water. The contrast between heat and cold can be approached at your own pace, whether it is part of a recovery routine, a reset after training or simply a way to slow down during the day.

The sauna is designed around the surrounding landscape, with open views and a warm, natural setting rather than the clinical feel often associated with traditional wellness spaces. After the heat, the cold plunge offers a refreshing change before guests can return to the surrounding lounge areas and take their time.

Entry to SUNDECK is IDR 200,000 per person for 3 hours, with no reservation required. Once inside, guests are welcome to settle into the sun loungers, enjoy the facilities and take in the views across the coastline. Food and drinks can be ordered from DAWN or DUSK and enjoyed straight from the sun loungers.
Open daily from 7am to 7pm, SUNDECK offers a slower space within Lago, somewhere to reset, stay a while and let the island do its thing.

[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

Just offshore from Lago, PONTOON offers a different way to spend an afternoon on Nusa Lembongan. Open to the public, the floating space sits out on the water somewhere between a relaxed lounge, a sunset bar and an ocean escape. Guests can take the complimentary shuttle boat from DAWN to PONTOON throughout the day, making it easy to head offshore whenever the mood takes you.

The experience is intentionally easy. Comfortable lounge areas and shaded seating make it possible to settle in for a few hours, while the open water and surrounding reef provide the setting. Come for a swim, take a snorkel, dive from the jumping platform, or simply find a spot to watch the waves.

For those looking to get into the water, snorkelling equipment is available to rent, subject to availability. The jumping platform offers two height options, while beanbags provide a place to stretch out between swims. For a little more adventure, guests can even catch a wave at the Playgrounds from PONTOON. There is no set way to spend the time here
column2: swim, settle in or simply let the afternoon unfold.

column1: Enjoy refreshing beverages throughout the day, from expertly crafted cocktails and chilled beers to wine and non-alcoholic options. As the afternoon moves on, the atmosphere changes with the light. The water becomes calmer, the sun begins to lower and the island takes on a different perspective from offshore. PONTOON is equally suited to an afternoon swim, a drink with friends or watching the sun set over the reef.

PONTOON is open daily from 12pm to 7pm, with the last complimentary shuttle returning at 6pm No reservation needed. For an afternoon spent between the island and the open water, PONTOON offers a slower, more unexpected way to experience Nusa Lembongan.

Located within Lago on Nusa Lembongan, FIRM is a modern training studio with a stunning sea view, built around movement, consistency and community. Offering reformer Pilates, mat Pilates and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, FIRM brings together different forms of training where the focus is on showing up, progressing and  the process.

FIRM’s Pilates training is designed to challenge and support different experience levels, whether you are new to Pilates, returning to movement or continuing an established practice. Daily group classes and private sessions provide flexibility for those looking to build consistency into their routine while travelling.

For Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, FIRM offers both Gi and No-Gi training, with structured classes and open mat sessions running throughout the week. Weekly Fundamentals sessions provide an accessible starting point for newcomers, while regular classes and open mats create space for everyone from curious beginners to experienced grapplers.
Expert-led classes and private sessions create an environment where guests can work towards their own goals while becoming part of a wider training community.

Whether you are looking to maintain your Pilates practice while on the island, learn the fundamentals of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, challenge yourself with a new discipline or simply move alongside good people, FIRM offers a space to train with purpose.

Set within Lago, the studio also makes it easy to continue the day beyond training. The beach and ocean are just minutes away, creating a natural transition from focused movement back into island life.

Located within Kalm Lembongan, the Movement Shala is housed in a beautiful 40+ year-old Javanese joglo, thoughtfully restored as an open-air space for movement and wellbeing in the heart of Jungutbatu.
Designed for yoga, Pilates, mobility and group movement, the Shala is open to everyone, including Kalm Lembongan guests, visitors staying elsewhere on the island and the wider Lembongan community.

Our movement program begins with a weekly schedule of yoga and Pilates, with more classes, instructors and movement experiences to be introduced as the program evolves. All equipment is provided, so you can simply arrive ready to move.
Beyond our regular schedule, the Shala provides a dedicated space for private sessions, workshops, wellness experiences and retreat programs.

For retreat hosts, the 120m² Shala can comfortably accommodate up to 40 guests, creating a considered space to bring your group together. With accommodation, dining, recovery, spa and communal spaces all within Kalm Lembongan, the Shala can form part of a complete retreat experience in one location.

No booking is required for our regular classes. Simply arrive at the Movement Shala 5–10 minutes before your session. Drop-in classes are IDR 100K and complimentary for Lembongan locals, with payment available at Kalm Lembongan reception or the Cowork Lounge.

A Culinary Escape to Morocco on Nusa Lembongan: Discover Mamati
[vc_separator type='transparent' position='center' color='' border_style='' thickness='' up='21px' down='']

While Nusa Lembongan is world-famous for its turquoise waters and laid-back island lifestyle, it is also home to a hidden culinary gem that brings a deeply personal story to the tropics: Mamati Moroccan Restaurant.

​Step away from traditional island menus and embark on an authentic sensory journey to North Africa. Far beyond simply serving Moroccan cuisine, Mamati is a celebration of family, heritage, and love. Every recipe on the menu has been lovingly passed down through generations, from grandmother to mother, and mother to daughter.
At Mamati, cooking is about transmitting the deep affection, generosity, and warmth learned at home in the family kitchen.
​The menu honors these cherished, home-cooked family recipes prepared with genuine passion:
​Slow-Cooked Tagines: Tender meats and fresh vegetables infused with aromatic saffron, cumin, and cinnamon, slow-cooked in traditional earthenware just as mom used to make.
​Authentic Handcrafted Couscous: Light, fluffy, and full of delicate spices—the ultimate comfort dish crafted for sharing with loved ones around the table.

column2: Homemade Breads: Golden, savory-sweet pastries and freshly baked breads prepared using family techniques and heartfelt dedication.
Refreshments: Indulgent sweet treats, house-made ice creams, and refreshing delicacies offering a sweet, comforting end to your evening.

column1: ​Whether unwinding after a day exploring the island or gathering for an intimate dinner with friends, Mamati welcomes you with genuine, open-hearted hospitality that makes you feel instantly at home.
​If you wish to experience true Moroccan comfort food—crafted with family love, rich heritage, and authentic flavors—Mamati is an absolute must-visit culinary stop during your stay on Nusa Lembongan.
